bluejetty:00083642:ios.summary: Easy BloodPressure is your comprehensive health companion for monitoring blood pressure, heart rate, and blood sugar levels. This intuitive app makes it effortless to track vital health metrics and gain valuable insights into your cardiovas
bluejetty:00083642:ios.description:
Easy BloodPressure is your comprehensive health companion for monitoring blood pressure, heart rate, and blood sugar levels. This intuitive app makes it effortless to track vital health metrics and gain valuable insights into your cardiovascular wellness.
Key features:
BLOOD PRESSURE MONITORING
- Quick recording of systolic, diastolic, and pulse measurements
- Color-coded categorization based on medical standards
- Detailed history with time and date stamps
HEART RATE MEASUREMENT
- Non-contact pulse detection using your phone's camera
- Instant heart rate readings in just 30 seconds
- Tracks resting heart rate trends over time
BLOOD SUGAR TRACKING
- Log fasting and post-meal glucose levels
- Categorize readings as normal, pre-diabetes, or diabetes ranges
- Monitor patterns throughout the day
COMPREHENSIVE ANALYTICS
- Interactive charts showing trends for all metrics
- Visual timeline of your health journey
Stay informed about your cardiovascular health with easy-to-understand insights. Whether you're managing hypertension, monitoring diabetes, or simply maintaining wellness, EasyBloodPressure provides the tools you need for proactive health management — all in one convenient app.
!!! We would like to remind you again that this app is only used to record blood pressure, heart rate, and blood sugar data to help you understand the trends of these health indicators and better manage your health. However, it cannot be used to diagnose or treat any diseases such as hypertension or diabetes. If you need to measure your blood pressure, diagnose a disease, or develop a treatment plan, we recommend that you consult a professional doctor. Furthermore, the functions and content in this app (including the function of measuring heart rate via camera) are not affiliated with Apple Inc. All measurement results are for reference only and should not replace professional medical advice.

bluejetty:00132241:ios.description:
Are spam and subscription emails flooding your inbox? Do you have hundreds, if not thousands, of useless emails making your cluttered mailbox impossible to navigate? Worry no more! Unroll.Me to the rescue!
Cleaning your inbox has never been so easy, or looked so good! With Unroll.Me, we’ll show you all the subscription emails in your inbox, and give you full control over what you want to do with them. Easily block unwanted emails, keep the ones you want, and rollup those that you don’t want to block, but also don’t necessarily want to see in your inbox.
Here’s what you can expect from Unroll.Me:
• View all subscription emails flooding your inbox and we’ll update this as we detect new subscriptions.
• Block, keep, and rollup your subscription emails, either in bulk or individually.
• Search your subscriptions easily so you can find that one company that won’t stop spamming you.
• Wanted to block an email subscription that you kept or rolled up? No worries, you can edit any and all changes that you’ve made to your subscriptions in the Subscriptions tab.
• View your rolled up emails - this updates once a day and we’ll send you a daily email of all new mail you received from your rolled up subscriptions. It’s like a daily digest email!
• Add multiple email accounts and tackle your subscriptions across all accounts with Unroll.Me.
• Support for the following email providers: Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo!, AOL, Outlook and Google Apps. More to come…
Stop stressing over your inbox and get back to spending time on what matters to you. Download Unroll.Me and get back the “you time” you’ve been missing.

bluejetty:00015787:ios.description:
An ad-free, free-to-use, simple text-to-speech app. Popular with people who want to memorize by listening, read more books, or study languages.
Recommended for:
• People who want to study efficiently
Use the camera or screenshots to recognize text from study books. Repeat playback helps with memorization, and playlists let you listen in order.
• People who want to read more
Listen to books and novels in your spare moments. Import PDFs and web articles to absorb information by ear.
• Language learners
Text is highlighted during playback, so you can read with both your eyes and ears. With AI voices, you can listen with natural, near-native pronunciation.
Main Features
・Text recognition from camera, images, and screenshots
・Playback position highlighting and auto-scroll
・One-tap voice speed changes
・Double-tap to play from a chosen position
・Background playback and remote controls
Ways to Import Text
・Create or paste text manually
・Text recognition from camera, images, and screenshots
・Scan web pages from the browser share menu
・Import from note apps via sharing
・Dropbox
・Evernote
・iCloud Drive
・Instapaper
Supported Files
text,pdf,image,epub,markdown,word(.docx)
Other
Install file-compatible apps and access them through the file button.
・Google Drive,OneDrive,Box,pCloud,Obsidian,Nextcloud,and many others
Playlist Features
・Repeat playlists
・Shuffle playback
・Turn playlists into audio files
・Copy playlists
・Move texts between playlists
Useful Features
・Edit text and titles
・Search within text
・Repeat text playback
・Sleep timer
・Change font size
・Bookmark text positions
・Automatically paste copied text
・Analyze text and switch voices
・Automatically switch languages in multilingual text
・Bulk text translation
・Share text and web links
・Backup and restore data
・Dark Mode support
Useful Settings
・Turn playback position memory on/off
・Register pauses
・Play speech while music is playing
・Change voices and speed by language
・Customize pronunciation
・Randomly change speakers
・Replace specified characters when importing text
・Automatically refresh Instapaper and Evernote at launch
Intuitive Controls
・Long-press a title to reorder the list
・Swipe left on a title to delete
・Swipe right on a title to move it to the top or to another playlist
・Swipe left on a playlist to delete, rename, or copy it
・Undo accidental deletions
Voicepaper Plus Benefits
・Unlimited listening
・Voice speeds above 1.6x
・Audio file creation
Voicepaper AI Benefits
・Load AI voices
・Keep the same intuitive controls
・Create audio files with AI voices

bluejetty:00145075:ios.name: PRESTO E-Tickets
bluejetty:00145075:ios.summary:
PRESTO E-Tickets, a new convenient and touchless way to pay your transit fare, are now available for Durham Region Transit (DRT), Hamilton Street Railway (HSR) and Oakville Transit customers.
PRESTO E-Tickets are digital tickets that can b
bluejetty:00145075:ios.description:
PRESTO E-Tickets, a new convenient and touchless way to pay your transit fare, are now available for Durham Region Transit (DRT), Hamilton Street Railway (HSR) and Oakville Transit customers.
PRESTO E-Tickets are digital tickets that can be conveniently purchased on your smartphone before boarding transit – there’s no more need to worry about finding the correct change before you hop on the bus.
Open the PRESTO E-Tickets app, choose an E-Ticket for the transit agency you are using, activate the E-Ticket and then scan the QR code on the barcode reader at the station or on the bus. An activated and scanned PRESTO E-Ticket on your smartphone is your proof-of-payment, so make sure you have it ready in case of fare inspection.
PRESTO E-Tickets are ideal for occasional riders and visitors or those who may have forgotten their PRESTO card. They can also be used for group travel as multiple tickets can be purchased, activated and displayed for payment by one individual on one smartphone.
PRESTO E-Tickets are currently available on Hamilton Street Railway (HSR), Durham Region Transit (DRT) and Oakville Transit. They are valid for travel on a single transit agency and do not count towards any loyalty programs, discounted transfers or co-fares that may be in place for PRESTO card or paper ticket users.
We recommend always having the latest version of your OS installed to make sure you get the best experience with the PRESTO E-Tickets app.

bluejetty:00168131:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00168131:ios.description:
Bookends is the reference management app you've been looking for.
The basic version offers:
• Search online sites directly (arXiv, Google Books, Google Scholar, JSTOR, the Library of Congress, PubMed, PubMed Central, and Semantic Scholar) or use the built-in browser (EZProxy-compliant) to download reference metadata and PDFs (access privileges required). Searches can return a maximum of 20 references, and only 50 references can be stored in your personal database.
• Use unique identifiers such as DOI, PMID, ISBN, or arXiv id to autofill references.
• View the text of PDF annotations in a note stream, and create your own with our powerful PDF markup engine.
• Barcode scanning, one per day.
• And many more features designed to help you discover, organize, and use reference information.
Standard, one-time purchase ($14.99):
• No limit on searches or importing.
Premium, yearly subscription ($14.99). Requires a Standard purchase.
• Cloud sync with all your iOS devices and Bookends for Mac (separate purchase).
• Share online libraries with colleagues.
• Scan documents with Mellel Mobile*.
• Create multiple libraries.
• Unlimited barcode scanning.
• Extract PDF annotations with deep links to annotations and text.
• Convenient UI to add PDF notes to the library.
• Automate your actions with Shortcuts.
* iPad-only. Requires a Mellel Mobile Premium subscription.
Subscription is for one year and has an auto-renew option. The subscription can be managed in iOS -> Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. A subscription will renew if it isn't canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
If the subscription is not renewed, Premium will be disabled but Standard will continue to work.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00073018:ios.summary:

PATIENT TRACKING, SHARED SEAMLESSLY
C
bluejetty:00073018:ios.description:
OB Tracker helps obstetric care teams track patients throughout pregnancy and postpartum, share patient details with colleagues, and keep everyone up to date across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud.
PATIENT TRACKING, SHARED SEAMLESSLY
Create and share patient groups with colleagues, giving everyone access to the same patient details. Updates stay in sync automatically with iCloud.
Designed for midwives, physicians, nurses, and other obstetric care professionals. Developed in collaboration with family physician Dr. Émilie Coudière, MD.
FLEXIBLE PREGNANCY DATING
• Calculate pregnancy dates from LMP (with cycle-length adjustment), ultrasound measurements, CRL, conception, or EDD.
• Check gestational age and conceptional age as of any date.
• See expected fetal length and weight based on gestational age.
• Quickly view important dates, including EDD, LMP, conception, and trimester milestones.
KEEP YOUR PATIENTS ORGANIZED
• See upcoming, past-due, and postpartum patients at a glance.
• Group patients by the month they’re due to see what’s ahead.
• Keep clinical information, contact details, and patient notes together.
• Select a patient’s phone number or email address to get in touch, or their address to get directions in maps.
TRACK PATIENTS THROUGH POSTPARTUM
Keep delivery details, newborn information, time since delivery, and complication notes together in one place.
SYNC AND SHARE WITH ICLOUD
Patient information syncs securely and exclusively through Apple’s iCloud.
Share patient groups with colleagues, each using their own iCloud account.
START WITH A FREE TRIAL
Try OB Tracker free for one month with full access to all features. Trial available to eligible new subscribers with either a monthly or annual subscription.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled. Pricing and trial details are displayed before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription directly in the app or through your Apple Account settings.
PRIVACY POLICY AND TERMS OF USE
Privacy Policy: https://jeffreyfulton.carrd.co
Terms of Use (EULA): http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00039871:ios.description:
Learn Medical English fast with Doxa — the app for doctors, nurses, students, and healthcare professionals.
Practice clinical communication, medical terminology, and real hospital dialogues to feel confident at work, in study, and during international exams.
Why Doxa works
• Real clinical dialogues – doctor–patient conversations based on actual hospital cases.
• Medical terminology you really use – from emergency care to daily rounds.
• Speaking practice – interactive scenarios to improve clinical communication.
• Fast learning method – spaced repetition and active recall (evidence-based memory techniques).
• Short lessons – learn in 3–5 minutes anywhere.
For all medical professions
• Doctors
• Nurses
• Paramedics and EMT
• Medical students
• Healthcare workers
Each profession gets the exact vocabulary and phrases needed on shift, in residency, or during patient care.
What you will learn
• Communication with patients
• Clinical questions and explanations
• Medical instructions and procedures
• Emergency phrases
• Hospital vocabulary and terminology
• Case presentation language
• Medical abbreviations
Perfect for work, exams, and career growth
Doxa helps with:
• OET Medicine / OET Nursing
• USMLE (clinical communication part)
• NCLEX and medical interviews
• Working in international hospitals
• Presenting clinical cases in English
Become confident in real clinical situations
Doxa is designed so you learn exactly what you need during rounds, handovers, triage, consultations, and emergency situations.
No unnecessary grammar. Only real medical English.
• Built for busy medical professionals
Short lessons, clear structure, and fast progress you can feel in days — not months.
• Start improving your medical English with Doxa.
Your patients, your career, and your future hospital team will thank you.

bluejetty:00179586:ios.description:
Your all-access pass to USGA championship golf. Stream Featured Groups live for free, track real-time scores across every USGA championship, and follow your favorite players from the U.S. Open to the U.S. Women’s Open Presented by Ally and beyond.
Key Features:
FREE LIVE STREAMING
Watch Featured Groups coverage of the U.S. Open and U.S. Women’s Open. See the world’s best players take on the toughest courses.
LIVE SCORING & STATISTICS
Follow every round of stroke play and every amateur match in real time. Favorite unlimited players to build your own custom leaderboard, and watch every televised shot from eight USGA championships with highlights embedded right in the player scorecards.
PERSONALIZED PLAYER TRACKING
Follow your favorite players for AI-powered round recaps, stat comparisons, and tailored highlights. Create a USGA Profile to sync favorites across the app and the championship website.
ON-SITE TOOLS FOR CHAMPIONSHIP ATTENDEES
Heading to the course? The USGA app is your perfect caddie for the day:
 • Mobile ticketing – manage, transfer, and resell tickets directly in the app
 • Interactive course map for the U.S. Open and U.S. Women’s Open
 • On-site push notifications with fan-specific updates and logistics
HIGHLIGHTS & VIDEO
Full-screen vertical story highlights put you closer to the action. Plus on-demand video, photo galleries, and the latest news from every USGA championship.
TEE TIMES & NOTIFICATIONS
See the latest tee times as soon as they are available. Turn on push notifications for score alerts, top highlights, and updates on the players you follow—including Live Activities for select championships.
CHAMPIONSHIP SHOP
Rep your favorite championship by shopping exclusive USGA merchandise, all within the app. Find the latest styles and special offers.

bluejetty:00160046:ios.description:
Get ready for a thrilling and engaging puzzle adventure! Wood Away brings you brain-teasing color block away gameplay that requires careful moves to complete within the time limit. Get ready to spend hours sharpening your mind, improving your problem-solving skills, and enjoying the ultimate color block puzzle challenge!
How to Play
- Your mission is simple: move the color block to their matching color gates. Sounds easy, right? But don’t be fooled! Wood away: Block Jam will challenge your logic, reflexes, and quick thinking as you clear all the color block within the time limit.
- Solve Color Block Puzzle: Use your logic, agility, and sharp reflexes to tackle mind-bending challenges.
- Unlock New Challenges: Each level brings a fresh puzzle that tests different thinking skills, keeping the gameplay exciting.
- Use Items Wisely: Power-ups can help you overcome tricky block away situations, but be strategic—use them at the right moment for maximum impact!
- Get ready for an addictive puzzle adventure that keeps you thinking, moving, and having fun!
A Puzzle Game You’ll Be Hooked On!
This puzzle game is the perfect mix of brain training and pure enjoyment—once you start, you won’t want to stop!
- Brain-Boosting Fun with Colorful Block – This game keeps your mind sharp while being incredibly fun! Match the block jam to their correct gates, test your reflexes, and enjoy a puzzle experience designed for true block puzzle lovers.
- Endless Unique Challenges – Every level brings something fresh and exciting! No two puzzles are the same, so you’ll always have a new challenge waiting for you. Think fast, plan smart, and conquer them all!
- Satisfying ASMR Moments – There’s something so satisfying about watching the color block break into tiny pieces as they land in the right spot. Smooth animations and calming sounds make each move feel incredibly rewarding.
- Exciting Obstacles Keep It Interesting – Just when you think you’ve mastered the game, new challenges appear! Each level introduces fresh block jam twists to keep you engaged and on your toes. Can you handle what’s coming next?
- Lifesaving Power-Ups at Just the Right Time – Some block jam are tricky, but don’t worry! Use powerful items at just the right moment. Plan your moves carefully, and you might just turn a near-loss into a brilliant win. A little strategy goes a long way!
Key Features
- Immersive Wood away Gameplay: Strategically move and align color block to solve engaging puzzle in this captivating color block puzzle game.
- Hundreds of Unique Levels: With a vast selection of levels, you’ll never run out of new color block jam and obstacles to solve.
- Beautiful & Engaging Graphics: Enjoy vibrant block jam and smooth animations that make gameplay visually appealing and immersive.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: Whether you’re on a break, commuting, or simply unwinding at home, enjoy this Wood Away game wherever you go.
A Stunning & Addictive Puzzle Adventure Just for You!
Get ready for a visually stunning and mind-bending puzzle journey that will challenge your thinking while keeping you completely relaxed! This game will twist your brain with color block puzzle in the best way possible, combining clever puzzles with deeply satisfying ASMR effects.
If you love block puzzle that make you think, feel, and enjoy every move, then Wood Away is here for you!
Join the Block Jam Craze!
Download this thrilling puzzle game today and immerse yourself in the addictive world of Block Jam! Whether you’re looking for a fun way to pass the time or an exciting brain-training challenge, this wood block adventure has everything you need for hours of entertainment. Play now and see if you have what it takes to master every level!

bluejetty:00146713:ios.description:
Para utilizar o aplicativo você precisa emitir um Certificado Digital em nuvem SafeID, junto a uma Autoridade Certificadora, credenciada no PSS Safeweb.
Com o aplicativo SafeID você pode acessar e assinar documentos pelo seu celular a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar, com validade jurídica e carimbo do tempo. Você também pode realizar assinaturas em outras aplicações, autorizando o uso do seu Certificado Digital, através do SafeID.
Conheça os benefícios de utilizar o SafeID:
- Assinatura de documentos pelo celular
- Assinatura com Carimbo de Tempo, no celular.
- Histórico de uso do seu Certificado Digital.
- Sincronização em múltiplos dispositivos.
- Validação de assinaturas no app.
- Acesso a serviços e portais do Governo Federal (ex.: GovBR).
- Dispensa o uso de token ou cartão.
- Armazenamento com altos padrões de segurança.

bluejetty:00161556:ios.description:
RAMP Gamsheets App ties directly into your RAMP Website League Games!
No internet access, no problem. Add Goals, Penalties and Goalie information offline and store them on your device. Sync the information as soon as you walk out of the building.
With 4 levels of access you can complete all tasks required to successfully add Gamesheets in Real-time.
1. Home Team Access // 2. Visiting Team Access
Add, edit and delete Players and Staff on your Roster. Sign-off on your Gamesheet Roster prior to the Game. View Notes and Incident Reports added by the Officials.
3. Full Gamesheet Access
View Rosters and Add Officials prior to the Game. Track Shots on Goal and Power Play opportunities. Add Goals, Penalties and Goalie information online or offline. Sync the information as soon as you have a connection. 
4. Officials Access
View the Rosters added by the Home and Visitor teams prior to the game. Review and Sign-off on the Game Summary for Goals, Penalties and Goalies at the end of the Game. Add Gamesheet Notes and Incident Report forms

bluejetty:00139227:ios.summary:
When the night falls, the war rises!
Nightfall: Kingdom Frontier TD is an adventure strategy tower defense game. It's a game about building a kingdom during the day and defending it from waves of attackers at night. Every day you spend coi
bluejetty:00139227:ios.description:
When the night falls, the war rises!
Nightfall: Kingdom Frontier TD is an adventure strategy tower defense game. It's a game about building a kingdom during the day and defending it from waves of attackers at night. Every day you spend coins turning little nodes in the landscape into structures: arrow towers and walls for defense, houses, mills, and farmlands for growing your economy. Some structures straddle the line between defense and economy. You can choose when building a mill, whether you want extra coin production or a mill that explodes when attacked causing damage. This game provides an excellent item system, hundreds of weapons and the defenses are divided into several different maps. 
The kingdom is built around a central hall, and this is the building that you're protecting at night when waves of enemies appear. You can ride out on your horse and lead the battle, and you can also rely on arrows from your arrow towers, and troops, which are created at any barracks you build, and which can then be led around and placed in useful spots with a few simple button presses. At night you defend, and every morning you get a shower of coins from any economy buildings you have and any coin-bearing monsters you've defeated, and you spend these coins on making your kingdom bigger. 
Build up your base during the day, defend it til your last breath at night. Build your kingdom during the day, strategically placing walls, towers, and barracks. Upgrade your defenses and train your troops to withstand the relentless attacks of darkness. When night falls, the battle begins. Take direct control of your forces, wielding powerful abilities to fend off hordes of menacing creatures. Fight bravely, for the fate of your kingdom rests in your hands. But defense is only half the story. Expand your territory, challenge other players, and prove your might as you strive for ultimate dominion.
Build your kingdom:
- Strategically allocate resources to construct walls, towers, and barracks.
- Upgrade your defenses and troops to withstand fiercer attacks.
- Expand your territory to uncover new challenges and rewards.
Defend your realm:
- Engage in thrilling combat against waves of enemies.   
- Command your troops wisely to overcome overwhelming odds.
- Use powerful abilities to turn the tide of battle.
Conquer your foes:
- Challenge other players in intense PvP matches.
- Prove your strategic prowess and become the ultimate ruler.
- Earn glory and rewards for your victories.
With its simple yet addictive gameplay, stunning visuals, and endless replayability, Nightfall offers a unique and exhilarating experience for strategy fans. 
Key Features:
- Dynamic Day and Night Cycle: Build and strategize during the day, then defend your realm against relentless attacks at night.   
- Intense Combat: Engage in thrilling, fast-paced battles with hordes of enemies.
- Deep Strategy: Build and upgrade your kingdom, manage resources, and develop powerful tactics.
- Competitive Multiplayer: Challenge other players and climb the ranks to become the ultimate ruler.
- Minimalist Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning and atmospheric world.
- Easy to play: Intuitive controls for easy pick-up-and-play
Can you manage to balance building your economy and strengthening your defenses? Do you need more archers, sturdier walls or another mill? Will you hold off the enemies with your longbow or charge at them on horseback? The night ahead will be challenging, but there's nothing like watching the sunrise over your kingdom and surviving for another day.
If you are a super fan of strategy tower defense games, classic tactics and strategy game, level-up games, action games, slow then fast, role-playing games and adventure games, don't miss this Nightfall: Kingdom Frontier TD - one of the most epic strategy tower defense adventure games and it's free. Download now and embark on your journey to become the greatest monarch!

bluejetty:00168983:ios.description:
Authenticator App is a highly secure application designed to provide two-factor authentication (2FA) for your online accounts. By generating unique security token/time-based one-time password (TOTP/OTP), the 2FA Authenticator app provides an extra layer of protection to your accounts when logging in, mitigating the risks of unauthorized access and identity theft and managing all your device online apps 2-factor authentication codes with just one authentication app. Support logging in with passkeys and accounts synchronization across all kinds of smartphones, tablets and mac using iCloud & Google Cloud.
We support any service that provides 2 step verification, including the most popular services like Microsoft, Google, Facebook, TikTok, PayPal, Amazon, Snapchat, Coinbase, Roblox, Discord, Twitch, Reddit, Epic, SAP, Shopify, Login.gov, Kick, Activision, NVIDIA, LastPass, Sony, One Healthcare ID, crypto, Stripe, Rockstar, Sprintax, Sterling, Ubisoft, Autotask, Instagram, Air Force, GitHub, mo.gov. Our 2fa Authenticator app ensures the security of your personal data and Apple passwords, safeguarding them from hackers and malicious attacks. Download this authenticator (T)OTP manager now to fortify your digital security!
Key Features:
1. Store and generate 2-factor Authentication code/security token. The 2 step verification code will update to a new one every 30 seconds.
2. Easy to setup two-factor Authentication. Scan QR Code or enter manually to add Authenticator secure ID, support import from Google Authenticator.
3. User-friendly guide. The 2FA authentication application has instructions that describe basic steps, such as adding 2FA/MFA/(T)OTP Code.
4. Encrypted sync & backup using iCloud & Google Cloud. Sync your accounts across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and any other smartphones or tablets.
5. Backup codes & Recovery codes. Easily manage and recognize codes using OCR. 
6. Support Passkeys. Enhance account security with passwordless logins and prevent hacking attacks.
7. Support Passwords. Auto generate strong passwords and enjoy AutoFill.
8. Widgets. You can access and copy your two factor Authentication Code on homescreen.
9. Live Activities. You can access the copied 2 step verification code & its validity time on Dynamic Island.
10. App level security by Face ID/Touch ID. You are the only one who can read your two factor authentication otp codes.
11. Folders. Too many keys? Don't worry, manage your keys with custom groups.
12. Support 14 languages: English, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Ukrainian.
Subscription Terms:
This (T)OTP Apple password/passkey authentication app offers monthly or annual subscriptions to provide you with unlimited access to all features while you maintain an active subscription.
1. Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. 
2. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
3. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
4. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase.
5. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
If you have any thoughts, questions or suggestions about our security service app, please feel free to contact us at feedback@firstorder.ai.
Home Page: https://authenticator.firstorder.ai
Terms of Use: https://authenticator.firstorder.ai/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://authenticator.firstorder.ai/privacy-policy-authenticator

● Mouth-watering cafe theme with cakes, pastries, and fancy drinks

● Satisfying sounds and cozy cafe visuals
● Easy to pick up, hard to put down—perfect for players of all ages!
Perfect for a quick break or a leisurely escape, My Dessert Cafe serves up a blend of relaxation and playful challenge. It’s your sweet little retreat—ready to whisk you away into a world of sugary fun, whenever you like! 🧁☕🎂

bluejetty:00166320:ios.summary: ZArchiver is a zip app to extract files, create archives in ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR file formats. Unpack numerous archive file formats: unZIP (extract ZIP files), unRAR (extract RAR files).. . As a stable application - ZArchiver Master is an att
bluejetty:00166320:ios.description:
ZArchiver is a zip app to extract files, create archives in ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR file formats. Unpack numerous archive file formats: unZIP (extract ZIP files), unRAR (extract RAR files).. . As a stable application - ZArchiver Master is an attractive unarchiver choice for mobile users around the globe.
ZArchive extractor will help you:
- Decompress multiple files at once quickly
- Create packaged ZIP, compress files
- Create and decompress password-protected archives;
- Quickly unZIP: open zipped files with extract file ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR opener feature
- Rar extractor/Extract file with multiple format types: RAR, ZIP, 7Z, TAR
- Supports large compressed files, zip reader
- Password to protect compressed files and create ZIP files with password
- Share zipped files, extract, compress word file easily
- Lock file/folder with password
Why do you need to compress files
- Quick sharing: The compression is like gathering files in one place and then packing them. This action helps you send multiple documents at the same time, it’s extremely convenient and fast.
- Keep the quality of photos, videos when sharing: You can pack (compress) before sharing if you want to send multiple photos, videos, audios... without losing their quality.
- Space saving: By compressing documents and archiving files, Z-Archive Master helps you organize documents neatly, tidy to save maximum memory space.
- Data security: Z-Archive supports compressing fils and decompressing Zip with passwords. As a result, the important and sensitive files will be totally protected.
Mini FAQ:
Q: What is the "ZArchiver in iCloud" folder?
A: It is a place to store data on iCloud. You will not lose your data when you delete the app or lose your phone.
Q: What is the "iTunes" folder?
A: It is a place to share data between your phone and computer via a signal cable or through Wi-Fi.
Q: What is the "Share" folder?
A: It is the folder that stores data when you share it from another app into ZArchiver.
Q: What password?
A: The contents of some archives may be encrypted and the archive can only be opened with the password (don't use the phone password!).
Q: The program is not working correctly?
A: Send me an email with detailed description of the problem. Email: contact@skysaver.net
Q: How to compress files?
A: Select all the files you want to compress by clicking on icons (from the top of menu -> click "Select"). Click on "Compress" from menu. Set desired options and press the OK button.
Q: How to extract files?
A: Click on the archive name and select suitable options ("Unarchive" or other).
Email us or leave a comment here, any useful ideas are welcome. Your contributions will help us continue to develop a better Z-Archive in future versions.
Thank you for reading. Hope you have a nice day!

bluejetty:00140516:ios.description:
Preparing for the most hilarious and thrilling chicken-themed arcade game you have ever played!
In Chicken Master: Run Challenge, you will guide a fearless flock of chickens through a series of outrageous mini-games designed to test your reflexes, strategy, and sheer willpower.
HOW TO PLAY?
1. Dalgona Challenge
Your task is to help the chickens carve out intricate shapes from a fragile dalgona candy. Steady your hand and guide the needle carefully.
2. The Glass Tile
Dare to cross the treacherous glass bridge with your brave chickens! Each step is a gamble - one tile is safe, while the other shatters under pressure. Use your memory and intuition to navigate this high-stakes game of chance.
3. Chicken Statues
Freeze instantly when the light turns red and dash forward when the light turns green. Stay vigilant and time your movements perfectly to survive this high-energy game!
4. Rope Pulling
Join forces with your fellow chickens to pull the opposing team across the line. Tap as fast as you can to gather the strength of your flock.
5. Flappy Chicken
Navigate through a series of power poles with precision and agility. Tap to flap your wings and keep your chicken airborne.
6. Flappy Space
Blast off into outer space with your favorite chickens in Flappy Space! Flap to conquer the Moai Statue in this galactic twist.
7. Squeaky Dunk
In Squeaky Dunk, help the chickens score as many baskets as possible. Let's flap to flick the chickens into the hoops with precision and speed.
FEATURES:
Endless Entertainment: Seven thrilling mini-games to keep you on your toes!
Charming Graphics: Adorable, vibrant visuals bring each chicken-filled adventure to life.
Intuitive Controls: Easy-to-learn, difficult-to-master controls that ensure players of all skill levels can enjoy.
Regular Updates: New mini-games, challenges, and special events will be added frequently to keep the fun fresh and exciting!
Join the feathered frenzy and see if you have what it takes to conquer the ultimate chicken survival challenge. Download Chicken Master: Run Challenge now and embark on a clucking good time!

Let's start with the ever-popular pizza! With kid's cooking diner game, you can create pizza masterpieces, complete with your favorite toppings like cheese, pepperoni, and vegetables, in your virtual kitchen. Experiment with different crusts and sauces, and make your pizza creations unique and delicious. Toddlers will love this cooking game!
Next up in our kid's cooking games for girls and boys, we have hamburgers—the ultimate comfort food! Create your juicy hamburger in the Cooking kitchen piled high with toppings like lettuce, tomatoes, and pickles. Kids can even add a twist by experimenting with different fun ingredients. The possibilities are endless in our fun cooking games!
If sushi is more of your style, our cooking game has you covered. With our sushi recipe, you will learn how to make perfect sushi rolls with delicious fillings. With easy-to-follow instructions, they'll be rolling sushi like a pro in no time in your virtual kitchen in this diner game!
Our delicious pasta recipe will be a hit with pasta lovers. You can choose your favorite pasta shapes, like penne or spaghetti, and experiment with different sauces, such as tomato, pesto, or alfredo.

**Also, check these new kids cooking recipes coming soon:**

bluejetty:00081226:ios.description:
Field Navigator: Precision Farming Made Easy
Field Navigator is the ultimate tool for modern farmers looking to enhance efficiency and accuracy in their field operations. Whether you’re managing large-scale agricultural fields or smaller plots, our app provides the precision and ease needed to navigate and optimize your work seamlessly.
Key Features:
Precision Navigation: Utilize advanced GPS technology to create and follow accurate field lines. Ensure consistent row spacing and reduce overlaps, saving time and resources.
Create and Manage Fields: Easily create field boundaries and navigation lines. Our intuitive interface allows for quick setup and adjustments, making it simple to manage multiple fields.
Save and Use Field Lines: Save your field configurations and reuse them for future drives. This feature ensures consistent operations and minimizes setup time for recurring tasks.
Comprehensive Tracking Options: Choose from various navigation patterns, including straight lines, curves, and adaptive tracks, to match the unique layout of your fields.
Operator Efficiency: Reduce operator fatigue with automated steering assistance. Focus more on critical implement settings and field conditions while the app handles the navigation.
Data Integration: Seamlessly integrate with major farming equipment and store your navigation data securely. Back up your field lines and settings in the cloud for easy access and management.
Precision farming, GPS navigation, field management, farm optimization, agricultural technology, crop management, automated steering, farm productivity, field navigator.
How It Works:

bluejetty:00061528:ios.description:
Penny Stocks List for iPhone is used to find hot penny stocks trading on NYSE and AMEX
Penny Stocks List shows a list of penny stocks gainers and losers filter by stock price and volume. The penny stocks app does not suggest which penny stocks to buy, watch or trade. A trader will have to make his own decisions, we do not suggest which are the best penny stocks to buy.
We do not include OTC penny stocks. 
You can filter penny stocks by stock price and volume to find the top penny stocks today.
You can search for stocks under $5, $2 and $1, and you can search for penny stocks by volume.
You will see the biggest penny stock gainers and losers of the day.
You will find the top 100 most active penny stocks each day with our penny stocks app.
Traders will see penny stock price information for each stock symbol and stock charts.
The penny stock app uses stock charts from Finviz. 
NOTE: Penny Stocks App is is delayed by up to 15 minutes. 
This is not a penny stock alert app, so you won't get any stock alert from us. You will use our penny stocks app to do research and manually add stocks to your watchlist. 
Please keep in mind penny stocks are risky stocks to trade, as they can go up or down very quickly.
You can make a lot money trading penny stocks when you do it right. It is much easier for a $2 stock to go up to $4 than for a $200 stock to go up to $400. However, there are a lot of risk involved when you trade penny stocks as they are very volatile. A stock that you buy for $2, may go up to $4, but it can also go bankrupt.

bluejetty:00027417:ios.description:
Autosport - formerly GP, will keep you up-to-date with the very latest action from the world’s top motorsport series - including F1, IndyCar, Sports Cars, Le Mans, Formula E and the World Rally Championship, to grassroots events, vital for producing the stars of the future. Every issue is packed with the latest news, followed by reports from all the races that week, as well as top features and Club Autosport, where all of the UK’s thriving motorsport scene is covered from the semi-professional levels to historics.
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.

• Launchpad Soundpack sharing - Get hundreds more genres and styles through our Launchpad for iOS app

• Real-time stretching - Change tempo while playing
• Real-time recording - Build up live recorded loops in real-time
• Import - Bring in your own sounds from other apps (In-App Purchase)
• Key aware - All library sounds stay in-key with each other

bluejetty:00153417:ios.name: Credo: Catholic Latin Learning
bluejetty:00153417:ios.summary:
Credo helps Catholics pray in Latin with real understanding — not through textbook drills, but through the beauty of prayer and story.
Whether you're preparing for the Latin Mass, teaching your children at home, or rediscovering the prayer
bluejetty:00153417:ios.description:
Credo helps Catholics pray in Latin with real understanding — not through textbook drills, but through the beauty of prayer and story.
Whether you're preparing for the Latin Mass, teaching your children at home, or rediscovering the prayers of your childhood, Credo helps you grow in both understanding and devotion.
WHAT MAKES CREDO DIFFERENT?
* You’ll read, hear, and practice real Catholic prayers like the Pater Noster, Ave Maria, and Angelus Domini -- and come to know what each word means.
* You won’t sit through boring drills or abstract rules.
* Instead, you'll learn Latin the way it was passed on: through prayer, story, and repetition in context.
INSIDE THE APP:
* Immersive lessons built around sacred texts and storytelling
* A complete Rosary, prayed bead by bead in Latin, in English, or both
* Oratio Continua — a timed, meditative prayer session that moves gently from one prayer to the next, to rest in or to fall asleep to
* Mini-games and reviews to reinforce vocabulary and help you memorize Latin prayers
* Traditional Catholic content, thoughtfully curated
* Family-friendly and perfect for homeschool use
WHO IT'S FOR:
* Converts and cradle Catholics alike rediscovering Latin through prayer
* Traditional Catholics who want to understand the Mass more deeply
* Parents and homeschoolers teaching children the language of the Church
* Anyone seeking to pray with greater understanding and intention
Credo is not a Latin textbook in app form. It's a formation tool -- a gentle companion for Catholics who want to pray with the saints, learn through tradition, and connect more deeply with the faith.
**Download Credo and begin your journey into the sacred language of the Church today.**
SUBSCRIPTION
Credo Premium unlocks full access to Credo. It is available as an auto-renewing monthly or annual subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your Apple Account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown in the app before purchase.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://credocatholic.app/tos
Privacy Policy: https://credocatholic.app/privacy

bluejetty:00015533:ios.name: Number Therapy Lite
bluejetty:00015533:ios.summary:
Numbers communicate so much, yet they are often left out of communication therapy. Now stroke survivors can practice understanding, saying, and typing numbers at home to improve these essential life skills.
Age, dates, phone numbers, addre
bluejetty:00015533:ios.description:
Numbers communicate so much, yet they are often left out of communication therapy. Now stroke survivors can practice understanding, saying, and typing numbers at home to improve these essential life skills.
Age, dates, phone numbers, addresses, money, time, measurements, fractions, weight, years – numbers are everywhere and so important. Be more independent with communication with stronger number communication skills.
Would you be able to understand, write down, and tell someone this phone message?
“Your appointment is at 3:15 p.m. on August 3rd, 2015 at 1650 18th Avenue. Bring $5. Please call back to confirm at 785-5662.”
Work on all these number skills and more with the evidence-based Number Therapy app!
Number Therapy Lite gives you a free way to test-drive the full functionality of the app with a sample from the 30 categories of numbers including:
*Single Digits
*Double Digits 
*Triple Digits
*Four Digits 
*Time
*Money
*Phone Numbers (add your own in the full version)
*Ordinals
*Fractions
Number Therapy offers thousands of unique exercises you can use anywhere. Number Therapy Lite gives you a taste so you'll know the app is worth using. Work at your own pace to practice the skills that matter to you.
This app has the same highly customizable, clean, intuitive interface you’ve come to love in Tactus Therapy apps. Developed in conjunction with people with aphasia, this app is designed to help you get the intensity of practice you need in a way that is easy to use.
Number Therapy also gives you recommendations for which level and settings you should use based on your score. See how easy it is to make progress when you're working at the right level for you! 
Speech-Language Pathologists: use Number Therapy to make the communication of numbers a part of your therapy plan for people with aphasia or other disorders. Three unique activities address auditory and reading comprehension, verbal expression, and written expression. Your clients can use the built-in hints, cues, and audio recording to be successful, then e-mail you their results in a professional report so you can track their progress over time. 
Ideal for use in the clinic and at home, add Number Therapy to your therapy app collection!
Number Therapy Lite is a FREE trial version of Number Therapy. 
What's the difference?
Lite = 4 categories with 7 items in each; Full = 30 categories with thousands of items
Lite = categories contain a mix of items from subcategories; Full = focus on just one subcategory at a time or mix & match
Lite = no custom phone numbers; Full = unlimited custom phone numbers
Lite = 7 exercises at a time; Full = 10, 25, 50, or 100 in a session
Once you've given it a try, you'll want to get the full version so you can truly master the communication of numbers and be more independent.
*Please note: this app does NOT address math skills or equations. It focuses on the communication of numbers, not calculations.

MAGICALLY SIMPLE

bluejetty:00068590:ios.description:
MAGICALLY SIMPLE
RosterElf is the employee roster app that lives in your pocket. Schedule shifts in seconds, track availability instantly and approve leave on the go. Named Xero’s Top Rostering App of 2024 and rated 4.8 stars on both Xero and Google, it’s the easiest way to manage people from anywhere.
WHAT MAKES ROSTERELF DIFFERENT
• Schedule fast – drag-and-drop rosters, copy last week or use templates. 
• Instant visibility – staff set availability in-app, conflicts disappear. 
• GPS clock-ins – precise attendance with optional photo proof. 
• Live labour costs – see wage totals before you publish, stay under budget. 
• One-tap payroll – export approved hours to Xero, MYOB and others with award rates applied automatically. 
• Real-time notifications – everyone sees shift changes, swaps and approvals right away. 
• Top-rated support – real humans by phone, chat and email.
POWERFUL FEATURES IN YOUR HAND
• AI-driven Perfect Match suggests the best staff for every shift. 
• Open Shifts & Shift Swaps fill gaps fast while managers stay in control. 
• Leave Management lets staff request time off, managers approve instantly. 
• Live Stats Dashboard shows attendance, coverage and wage spend in real time. 
• Automated Onboarding stores documents and tracks progress. 
• Unlimited Locations & Positions under one login.
BENEFITS FOR OWNERS & MANAGERS
Save up to eight hours a week on admin, cut labour by about four per cent, manage rosters and attendance remotely and stay Fair Work compliant with automatic award interpretation.
BENEFITS FOR EMPLOYEES
Clock in and out from anywhere, keep availability up to date, request leave or swaps in two taps and receive instant shift notifications.
Join cafés, retailers, healthcare clinics, venues and thousands of other businesses who trust RosterElf to keep their teams running smoothly—whether they’re on site, on the floor or on the move.

bluejetty:00017218:ios.description:
Good logic game to relax your brain
Professional sudoku puzzle game
All puzzles are tested by program
Suitable for beginner and expert
Clear graphics and rich functions
Compete with sudoku expert worldwide
We absolutely believe that HangXun Sudoku is the best Sudoku game for you and it is a free Sudoku game with all the free puzzles. Whether you want to relax or keep your mind fresh - this pleasant pastime is suitable for both purposes! Take a small stimulating break or clear your mind with sudoku exercises. Take your favorite apps with you wherever you go. Playing Sudoku as a mobile version is just as nice as playing with a pen and paper.
Welcome to Sudoku World! Train your brain now!
Features:
1. 50000+ sudoku puzzles, all are tested by program.
2. Puzzles are from easy to hard, which are suitable from all players.
3. Complete the daily challenge, and compete with other experts.
4. Game levels include 9000 puzzles, from easy to hard.
5. More than 190 trophies, 30 thousands of puzzles, are waiting for your challenge.
6. Turn on the pen mode to take notes like paper. Each time you fill in a cell, the notes update automatically!
7. Highlight double numbers so that you do not accidentally repeat numbers in a row, column, or field.
8. Hints help you move forward when you are stuck.
9. Sudoku Editor and Sudoku Solver help create your own puzzles.
10. Sunset and midnight themes make eyes feel more comfortable.
More features:
1. Long tap a number to lock it, and use it for multiple cells. Enable the function in settings page.
2. Smart hint can help you analyze the sudoku puzzle step by step.
3. When you select a cell with a number, the notes of same number are highlighted.
4. Support phone and tablets.
5. Player ranking and daily ranking for compete.
6. Highlight duplicates numbers in same row, column and block.
7. Highlight cells which are in same row, column and block.
8. Auto-Save unfinished game.
9. Unlimited undo.
10. Excellent sound effect.
11. Timer, you can also disable it in settings.
12. Change your profile photo on Me view.
How to play sudoku?
- Sudoku puzzle consists of a grid of 9 blocks.
- Each block contains 3 rows and 3 columns grid.
- Some grids are pre-filled with numbers, which cannot be changed.
- The objective is to fill all the grids with 1 to 9 numbers,and each column, each row, and each of block contains only one of each digit.
Thanks for your selecting HangXun Sudoku Game! We will try our best to make the game better and better.

bluejetty:00122306:ios.description:
World's coolest match 3 puzzle adventure, Water Splash!
Match colorful water balloons and shoot cool water stream! Abound in beautiful landscaping with adorable otter Oris. Match water balloons of a same color as many as possible to defeat villain Croker who invaded the Animal city and blocked the town's waterway oneday!
Match and pop soft bouncy water balloons like pudding to clear levels for Oris and his animal friends! You can travel all around the world from Oris' cradle to the Caribbean! Bring your favorite snacks and lolly pops to prepare your adventure!
Water Splash features : 
◆ Never ending exciting match 3 puzzle cool game!
More than 4,000 levels, more new ones every week!
◆ How to play Water Splash
Match 3 or more balloons of a same color as many as you can!
Match 4 or 5 balloons will give you powerful and special boosters shooting strong water stream like a fountain!
◆ Go Rubber Duck! Get rid of all obstacles!
Try the Dart, Color Balloon, Toy Shovel and Rubber Ducky to remove obstacles such as mini crocodiles, dolphins throwing tubes and rubber cones. Eliminate all the obstacles, win levels and feel refreshing pleasure as if you're drinking cool limeade in hot summer!
◆ Whenever, wherever you are, match 3 cool game must go on!
You can always enjoy Water Splash without internet access and Wi-Fi. Anywhere, anytime match the balloons!
◆ Who is the best match 3 mania?
Let's play with friends and compete for higher scores! Water Splash will evoke fellowship and friendship altogether. Let's earn 3 stars on all levels and be royal puzzle match mania!
◆ Don't miss out special gifts!
Sign in with Facebook right now and exchange presents with your friends. Play Water Splash every day and Oris will bring you wonderful jewelry too!
◆ App Store free download
Water Splash is FREE to play while some game items such as extra moves, lives and jewelry can be also purchased if you like to quickly clear levels.
◆ What's new?!
Graphics got more colorful and vibrant!
Now you can load Water Splash faster!
◆ Languages available in the game: English, Deutsch, Nederlands, Français, Italiano, Norsk bokmål, Pусский, Português, 한국어, Bahasa Indonesia, tiếng Việt, हिंदी
Are you ready for abound match 3 puzzle cool game, Water Splash?
Visit us on Facebook and share your Water Splash moment and collected landscaping with friends : https://www.facebook.com/playwatersplash/

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. bluejetty:00128565:ios.description:
Come back to the Jurassic era with me to hear the story of Dino - the cutest dinosaur babysitter of the Bubble Jungle.
Because Dino is a kind and child-loving dinosaur, he wants to do something to help the dinosaur parents have more time to forage and reclaim the wasteland. Therefore, one day he decides to become a babysitter of the Bubble jungle. All the dinosaur parents in the forest are very happy and bring their children to Dino to take care of and start their adventure to find new lands. However, becoming a babysitter is not as easy as Dino thought. The baby dinosaurs are extremely naughty. They run, play around and get stuck everywhere in the bubble forest. Dino struggles to shoot bubbles and colorful dinosaur eggshells to find and rescue the baby dinosaurs before their parents return.
Let's play, relax and help our cute dinosaur babysitter, Dino.
FEATURE OF BUBBLE SHOOTER - PRIMITIVE DINOSAURS - EGG SHOOT
- There are more than 3000 levels waiting you to explore in the primitive land with dinosaur
- That Dino Game is one of the most entertaining, addictive and time-killing games for you
- Bubble Shooter - Primitive Dinosaurs brings to dino and bubble shooting game lovers a chance to meet many cute dinosaurs such as Stegosaurus, Pterodactyl, T- Rex and Elasmosaurus.
- Cute image, colorful bubble eggs, beautiful sound, gorgeous special effects
- The game is suitable for all ages so you will have a good time with your friends and your family 
- You are not alone, magical animal friends will help you with special bubble bomb
- All offline, no need for connection! Free for download! Just play whenever and wherever you want, without limits.
HOW TO PLAY BUBBLE SHOOTER - PRIMITIVE DINOSAURS - EGG SHOOT
- Match 3 or more bubbles of of the same color to blow up the dinosaur eggs
- Swap the bubbles to match & pop more
- Help Dino clear all bubble-eggs and free all baby dinosaurs before their parents come back.
- Try to get 3 stars to show your bubble shooting skill.
- Use the booster to make it easier to complete game levels. Our magic animal friends always willing to support you
What are you waiting for? Get ready for a new bubble shooting adventure with adorable dinosaurs right now. Hopefully, This Dino Game will make your day become more interesting and colorful

bluejetty:00039468:ios.description:
نجدة تقدم حلول متكاملة للخدمات المنزلية مع الالتزام بأعلى معايير الجودة والدقة بباقات متعددة تلبي رغبات شركاء نجاحها، يمكنك اختيار التاريخ والوقت وإعادة جدولة المواعيد مباشرة من التطبيق.
نجدة بدعم وتشغيل شركة عبد المجيد عبدالرحمن الجريسي للموارد البشرية وهي صرح اقتصادي رائد تأسس في عام 2013؛ ليحتل منذ ذلك الحين موقع متميز ومتخصص في تلبية احتياجات السوق المحلي لمختلف القطاعات والأنشطة.
مميزات خدمات نجدة هي:
خدمات التنظيف المنزلي بنظام الزيارات (4 ساعات للزيارة).
خدمات التنظيف المنزلي بنظام المقيمة (إقامة دائمة).
مختلف الجنسيات (اندونيسيا - افريقيا )
حجز سهل وسريع.
إعادة جدولة الزيارة وتغيير المواعيد.
دعم فوري من خلال المحادثة الفورية لخدمة العملاء باحترافية و مهارة.
اسطول من النقل والعمليات اللوجستية لتقديم خدمات التوصيل المنزلي السريع وبالموعد.
تجديد العقد من خلال التطبيق مباشرة.
الاطلاع واختيار السير الذاتية بكل راحة وسهولة.
قنوات سداد متنوعة (آبل باي – مدى – فيزا – ماستركارد – أميركان اكسبرس)

bluejetty:00091567:ios.name: DrHouse: Online Doctor Service
bluejetty:00091567:ios.summary:
◆ Choose a doctor you like and get a diagnosis & treatment in minutes.
◆ Pick up an Rx from your preferred pharmacy or use our convenient 1-hour Rx delivery².
◆ Request a work/school excuse if needed.
◆ Insurance is accepted but not require
bluejetty:00091567:ios.description:
◆ Choose a doctor you like and get a diagnosis & treatment in minutes.
◆ Pick up an Rx from your preferred pharmacy or use our convenient 1-hour Rx delivery².
◆ Request a work/school excuse if needed.
◆ Insurance is accepted but not required.
Our online doctors are available 24/7 in all 50 states, even on holidays.
At DrHouse, we offer comprehensive and cost-effective virtual doctor services. Our highly trained physicians are specialized in 14 different medical specialties (including family physicians, pediatricians, OB-GYNs, cardiologists, internal medicine doctors, and more), providing the highest quality of care. All DrHouse providers are MDs and DOs. Our physicians are in-network with Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, UnitedHealthcare, Medicare, and other major insurance providers.
What do we offer?
◆ 24/7 virtual visits - See board-certified physicians from the top U.S. medical schools within minutes for an online doctor visit.
◆ Rx as needed¹ - See our physicians whenever you need a new Rx or refill/renew an existing Rx. In select areas, we can deliver prescription medication to you within one hour of your visit.²
◆ Doctor's notes - Get a doctor's excuse and/or clearance for your school or work if needed.
◆ On-demand support - Chat with our support whenever necessary. They are here for you 24/7.
How does it work?
1. Download the DrHouse online doctor service app to schedule a visit with a doctor. The visit will take place in the DrHouse app.
2. Get an Rx¹ and/or doctor's note¹ - Pick up an Rx from your preferred pharmacy. In select areas, we can deliver prescription medication to you within one hour of your visit.²
Our pricing:
A one-time visit costs $0 to $129, depending on your insurance.³ You can pick up and pay for your medications at your preferred pharmacy, or we can deliver them to you within one hour of the visit (available in select areas).²
We offer a world-class care team:
◆ Our online doctors are board-certified and trained in top U.S. medical schools, with an average of more than 20 years of experience.
◆ They are qualified to diagnose and treat various non-emergency conditions.
◆ We approach patient care with the best clinical practices to provide a seamless healthcare experience.
What we treat:
Our physicians diagnose and treat a wide range of medical conditions, caring for patients from birth. Our physicians treat for example, UTIs, Cold/Flu, Sinus infections, Cough, Fever, Headaches, Nausea, Wheezing, Fatigue, Allergies, Back pain, Stress & Anxiety, Depression, Erectile Dysfunction, Weight Loss, STDs, Hair loss, Blood pressure, Cholesterol, Minor sports injuries, Vaginal infections, Acne, Dandruff, Rosacea, Sunburn, Birth control, Menstrual problems and more.
Your medical information, health records, and doctor's visit are confidential and HIPAA compliant. Additionally, DrHouse is a LegitScript-certified healthcare provider.
¹Having a visit does not guarantee a medication will be ordered or refilled. It is our physicians' professional decision. Our physicians don't prescribe gabapentin, medical marijuana, or controlled substances! Your provider may recommend follow-up care, including additional services (for example, labs) that may not be included in the visit price.
²Our 1-hour prescription delivery is available in select areas nationwide. We are opening new delivery areas every week. If the delivery is available in your area, an app screen displaying the delivery information will be presented to you as an option when completing the intake form.
³DrHosue does not offer any subscriptions or memberships, and the pricing is for one-time visits. Most major insurance and HSA/FSA cards are accepted.

Experience the world's best Objectivist content in one place with the official app of the Ayn Rand Institute.
Learn Objectivism from the world's leading experts and Ayn Rand herself through fifty years of courses, lectures, videos, and articles.

Have a question about what Ayn Rand thought or said? Aria, ARI's AI research assistant, will tell you—and exactly where it found it. It’s the fastest way to find what Ayn Rand actually thought: no summaries detached from sources, no hallucinations, just precise, fully cited answers.

ARI is dedicated to sharing and preserving Ayn Rand's intellectual legacy. ARI's Archives house the world's largest collection of Ayn Rand's resources, many of which are available exclusively through the app, with new material added all the time.
Access All of ARI's resources
Find all of the Ayn Rand Institute's content, including videos, podcasts, courses and more, featuring commentary on current events, culture and ideas from experts dedicated to preserving and extending Ayn Rand's intellectual legacy.

Unlock the world of language with Bangla Translate Master, your all-in-one English to Bangla translation app. Whether you're looking to translate text, scan images for instant translations, or enhance your English vocabulary, this app has it all.

Key Features:

English to Bangla Dictionary: Access a comprehensive dictionary with extensive word definitions, synonyms, and usage examples to improve your language skills.

Image to Text Scanner: Effortlessly translate text from images. Simply snap a picture and get accurate translations in seconds.

English to Bangla Translator: Instantly translate sentences and phrases from English to Bangla and vice versa with our powerful translation engine.

Learn English from Bangla: Enhance your English proficiency by learning through Bangla. Our interactive lessons and exercises make language learning engaging and effective.

English Vocabulary Enhancer: Boost your vocabulary with daily word suggestions, flashcards, and quizzes tailored to your learning pace.

Idioms & Phrases: Master commonly used idioms and phrases to sound more natural and fluent in conversations.

With Bangla Translate Master, breaking language barriers has never been easier. Download now and start your journey towards mastering both English and Bangla!

bluejetty:00118736:ios.description:
Most notes apps lose track of time. You write something, it disappears into a folder, and a week later you can't remember why you made that decision or what you prepared for that meeting.
Agenda fixes this. Every note lives on a timeline alongside your calendar. Prepare for next week's client meeting, capture decisions as they happen, and look back at exactly what led you here — all in one view.
"It's my favorite new app in years."
— John Gruber, daringfireball.net
"Every notes app should work like Agenda."
— Khoi Vinh, subtraction.com
"One of the most interesting note-taking apps I've used."
— John Voorhees, MacStories
YOUR NOTES, CONNECTED TO YOUR CALENDAR
Attach any note to a date or link it directly to a calendar event. Mark notes as "On the Agenda" to surface them in a dedicated overview — your shortlist of what matters right now.
A REAL TEXT EDITOR
Headings, lists, tables, checklists, indented blocks, and preformatted text — with the simplicity of plain text input. Focus on what you're writing; Agenda handles how it looks.
FILES, PHOTOS, AND LINKS
Attach files and images to any note. Everything syncs across your devices and can be previewed inline.
PROJECTS AND CATEGORIES
Group notes into projects, group projects into categories. Drag to reorder, collapse to focus, or let the timeline do the organizing for you.
MAC, IPAD, AND IPHONE
Agenda syncs across all your devices via iCloud or Dropbox. Share individual notes for real-time collaboration — useful for team meetings or shared lists.
FREE TO USE, FOREVER
Agenda is free with no time limits. Premium features are available through a yearly subscription — and you keep every feature you unlock, even if you cancel. A one-time lifetime purchase is also available.

bluejetty:00128106:ios.description:
Reach your weight and nutrition goals with a food tracker that's fast, beautiful, and genuinely private. Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, or maintain — EatWell counts calories and macros, tracks water and workouts, and helps you eat better without ever asking for an account.
PRIVACY FIRST
No signup. No account. No tracking. Everything you log stays on your iPhone — never on our servers.
LOG FOOD IN SECONDS
AI Camera — snap a photo of your meal for an instant calorie estimate
Barcode scanner for packaged foods
Huge searchable food database
Quick Add for fast manual entries
Save favorites and frequent meals
Detailed nutrition info — protein, carbs, fat, fiber, and more for every food
HIT YOUR GOALS
Calorie and macro targets calculated for your body and goal
Keto, Paleo, Mediterranean, Vegan, or fully custom macros
Water Tracker with a home screen widget
Workout logging with calories burned
Daily diary across breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Clear charts to see your trends over time
FITS YOUR LIFE
Apple Health sync
Daily logging reminders
VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support
Available in English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish
EatWell is free to use, with optional Premium for advanced features. Premium unlocks all diet presets and custom macro ratios, unlimited diary entries, continuous food database and barcode scanner updates.
Powered by fatsecret nutrition API (www.fatsecret.com)
Subscription details: Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings.
Terms & Privacy Policy: https://eatwelldiary.com/terms/

HomeExchange is the world leader in home and apartment exchanges with a community of over 250,000 members in 155 countries.
The site allows members to find an economical and comfortable accommodation solution to go on vacation with ease thanks to the innovative GuestPoints system and with complete peace of mind thanks to strong guarantees that protect your exchanges and your home.
Save time and do more with the HomeExchange mobile app: search available homes, live chat with HomeExchange members, add images of your home directly from your phone.
Download the HomeExchange app now!
Six tips for using the app:
1. Register for free, complete your profile, and post your accommodation
2. Subscribe to the annual membership to access all the features and benefits
3. Specify the destinations of your choice and add the houses and apartments to your favorites list
4. Contact other members through our integrated messaging system to plan your next trip 
5. Finalize your exchange by agreeing with your exchange partners
6. Leave with peace of mind and access all the information about your exchange location through the application
Follow us on Twitter and Instagram @homeexchangecom
And Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/homeexchangecom/

bluejetty:00137816:ios.description:
Transform Your Pet into a Star with Talking Pet: AI Face Animation!
Make your beloved pet the centre of attention with our fun and engaging Talking Pet: AI Face Animation app! This unique app brings your pet photos to life through live animation, making every moment hilarious and memorable. Whether you have a quirky cat or a delightful dog, this app will turn their photos into entertaining animations that you can share with friends and family.
Key Features:
- Live Animation: Watch in awe as your pet's photo comes alive! Our sophisticated live animation technology breathes life into every picture.
- Auto-Tracking: Our app automatically recognizes your pet’s unique facial features to ensure animations are smooth and lifelike.
- Mimic - Face Animation: Your pet's animated alter ego will mimic facial expressions and movements, providing endless entertainment.
- Background Changer: Set your animated pet against a variety of fun and whimsical backdrops to match the mood or occasion.
- Funny Masks and Effects: Add a touch of whimsy with our collection of funny masks and effects, perfect for giving your pet's animation that extra flair.
How to Use:
1. Start with a Photo: Simply upload a favourite photo of your pet directly from your device.
2. Choose a Song: Select a tune from our library that best fits your pet’s new animated personality.
3. Customise: Add hilarious masks and effects to enhance the animation. Choose different backgrounds to set the scene.
4. Enjoy Live Animation: Watch as your pet sings along to the music and interacts with the effects. Save your creation or share it online to amuse your friends and family!
Get ready to unleash your creativity and see your pet in a whole new light with Talking Pet: AI Face Animation. Download the app today and start the fun!
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS 
Talking Pet offers auto-renewing weekly and yearly subscriptions to 'Talking Pet Pro'. Talking Pet Pro has no limit on saving and sharing videos, has no watermark on videos, unlocks special features as changing background on your photo and live animation - real-time animation with funny effects and masks.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
----
In case of any questions, issues, or collaboration requests, contact us at support@blowy.tech

bluejetty:00136282:ios.description:
Start your zero to hero adventure! Fight your way through a magnificent and massive world map by summoning and leveling up your mythic heroes, gathering with allies to hunt the legendary BOSS, occupying towers, and becoming the strongest one!
Legends Reborn is:
Combination of easy and fun IDLE RPG gameplay, extraordinary 3D graphics, fun and strategic exploration, imaginative heroes with unique personalities and own stories, accompanied by captivating voices of the world's most famous and talented voice actors like Fred Tatasciore, Laura Bailey, Marisha Ray, Matthew Mercer,Robbie Daymond, Nika Futterman and others.
What is waiting for you in Legends Reborn:
The map full of mystery:
An exciting adventure full of surprises and battles to fight. Unlock the unknown areas one by one and open new challenges. Build your own tactics, defeat all enemies on your way while traveling through forest, desert, mountains, sea and other fantastic locations. Master factional attributes and counter strategies, level up your squad, and show your power. You are the one who makes decisions and chooses direction of the adventure. Don't forget to stay alert, you never know what monsters are waiting for you down the aisle.
Relaxing Auto Farming
Take the most out of your heroes and send your squad for resource farming battles even when you are offline. Discover lots of different farming locations on the world map and see what you can get.
Epic BOSS Battles
Fight challenging BOSS battles for rich rewards! BOSS battles can be tough but also exciting and joyful if you find chink in thier armor! Take chances, make mistakes. That's how heroes grow!
PVP & PVE Battlefields
Follow the main campaign and go through the fascinating storyline, face diverse enemies and beasts in PVE battles or challenge other adventurers in PVP arena!
Labyrinths & Mazes
For lovers of crytical thinking and risk taking- labyrinths and mazes full of unpredictable actions and puzzles to solve. Save Armuda from the Fallens attack and who knows, maybe you are the one who is going to be on the top of world ranking.
Only you can decide your fate! Explore now!

bluejetty:00026017:android.description:
Are you bored with your social media content?
It's time to refresh your social media content and surprise your friends. This app helps you replace any face in a photo or video with your own, generate professional portrait photos and themed headshots, create a funny talking head or make your avatar sing a song, change any voice from audio or video with your voice, and turn your face into any cartoon style. And many other AI tools can help you satisfy your creative purposes.
This application includes a complete set of AI tools for you to unleash your creativity with your face. With many up-to-date face filters and trending videos, it could be your must-have application on your phone if you are a content creator or you are the one who just wants to make your social content cool and fresh every day.
FEATURES:
We are adding more tools every day.
- Swapping faces: This application provides you with realistic face change effect. Get 100% real-look AI face for any purpose in seconds.
- Photo generator: The AI photo generator lets you create professional-looking business headshots, profile pictures, and social media posts.
- Creating a talking avatar (talking head): AI talking avatar or talking photo can make a picture come alive. It turns still images into lifelike character and helps deliver information with real voices.
- Voice changer (Voice cloning): also known as voice synthesis or voice mimicry, is a technology that uses machine learning to simulate a specific person's voice. It can generate speech that sounds very similar to the original voice.
- Cartoon yourself: Turn your photos or videos into various animation styles. Let our AI cartoonize your photos and videos.
USE CASES:
You can use this application for your own purposes.
1. Face swapping
- Change face in photo in a snap: Generate face-swap models for joy, projects and more to create swap face effect easily and fast.
- Reface models for art projects: Seamlessly swap faces in any art project using face swapper.
- Experience the gender swap effect: Try your outlook in different sexes and confuse your friends or families.
- AI face swap free for headshot: Stop spending much time and money on taking various themes headshots for different occasions.
- Get your hair mockup with AI face changer: Explore more possibilities of your outlook by changing hair styles and hair colors.
2. Generate images (photo maker)
- Easily and quickly create professional and realistic HD AI headshots and profile pictures.
- AI profile, AI headshots, AI magic, AI yearbook, AI business photo...
3. Animate photos
- Business: Create a speaking portrait video to promote your brand and introduce a new product or service.
- Education: Transform teaching materials, documents into videos.
- Customer support: Provide solutions of how to use a product, how to troubleshoot an issue with talking head videos.
4. Voice cloning:
- Podcasts & Ad Reads: Create entire podcasts, ad reads, or segments, in your voice without speaking a word.
- Announcements: Need to make daily announcements for your company or even public announcements? Simply upload a script.
- Marketing & Social: Create personalized messages, voicemails without speaking a word.
5. Toonify (Cartoon yourself)
Transform your avatar or videos into variety of animation styles.
DISCLAIMER
This software is meant to be a productive contribution to the rapidly growing AI-generated media industry.
The developers of this software are aware of its possible unethical applications and are committed to take preventative measures against them. This project may include watermarks on the output if requested by law.
Users of this software are expected to use this software responsibly while abiding the local law. Developers of this software will not be responsible for actions of end-users.
SUPPORT
Email: sutv.app@gmail.com
