My goodness...What the hell is that!?
Keep quiet, idiot!
Arrrrgh, the zombie's coming at us!!!
The outbreak of a deadly virus swept over the world. Almost all of humanity have turned into zombies. Lead your followers to survive the apocalypse: that is your quest.
Match-3 Puzzle meets Strategy! Solve the mysteries and build an impenetrable sanctuary. The future of humanity is in your hands.
Tip: Use your brain to defend your brain!
——APOCALYPTIC FEATURES——
※ STRATEGY + MATCH-3
- Solve puzzles to kill zombies
- Arm yourself with strategy and tactics
- A combination of a tactical wargame and casual puzzle gameplay
- An innovative post-apocalyptic experience
※ BUILD A SANCTUARY
- Lead survivors in the last bastion of humanity
- Craft cutting-edge equipment to smash your enemies
※ FORMIDABLE HEROES
- Superhuman powers emerged alongside the zombie virus
- Recruit Heroes from the notorious Noah\'s Tavern
- Heroes improve your military and economical strength
※ FRIENDS OR FOES
- No one can survive alone, fight alongside your allies
- Watch out for potential threats, be they zombies or humans
Official Facebook fan page: https://www.facebook.com/PnS.37Games

Puzzles & Survival is a free-to-play mobile game with in-app purchases. According to 37GAMES\' Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, this application is not intended for use by users under the age of 12.

6. To manage and cancel subscriptions, please head to Settings - iTunes Store & App Store - Check Apple ID - Account Settings - Subscription.

bluejetty:00019375:ios.description:
EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE FLIGHT SIMULATOR ON YOUR MOBILE DEVICE!
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator. Our cutting-edge flight simulation technology allows you to experience the thrill of being a pro pilot from your device. Whether you want realistic airplane games or a professional flight simulator, RFS delivers an unparalleled journey.
FLY NOW, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD!
Learn to take off, land, and complete full flights in a global flight simulation environment. Explore aircraft with 3D live cockpits, visit 30 HD airports, and navigate 500 SD airports. Personalize instruments, use automatic flight plans, and experience the finest detail in this global flight simulator. Master your skills with our pilot tutorials and become a master of flight simulation!
Manual/Tutorial: Real Flight Simulator Wiki
UNLOCK THE FULL REAL FLIGHT SIMULATOR EXPERIENCE
Choose the subscription that fits: monthly, six-month, or yearly. Join virtual aviators and access premium features in the most advanced airplane simulator and flight simulator available on the App Store.
BUCKLE UP AND BECOME A REAL PILOT!
As a pro pilot in our flight simulator, you will enjoy a vast array of features for the ultimate flight simulation:
• 60+ AIRPLANE MODELS: Take command of airplane models with realistic 3D cockpits and authentic lighting. Experience pilot systems and instruments in every flight.
• 1900+ HD AIRPORTS: Land your airplane at 3D airports featuring realistic buildings, vehicles, and authentic ground procedures. This is the most detailed airport simulation in a mobile flight simulator.
• REAL-TIME FLIGHTS & WEATHER: Join 40,000+ real-time flights daily with live air traffic at global hubs. Experience real-time weather that challenges your pilot skills in this realistic flight simulator.
• DETAILED CHECKLISTS: Follow authentic pilot procedures for takeoff and landing to fully immerse yourself in the flight simulation.
• ADVANCED GROUND SYSTEMS: Interact with refueling trucks, passenger vehicles, and follow-me cars upon landing your airplane.
• ADVANCED FLIGHT PLANNING: Customize real-time weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots for a connected flight simulation community.
• AUTOPILOT & ASSISTED LANDING: Utilize precise autopilot and our Automatic Landing System for long-haul airplane missions.
• REALISTIC SATELLITE SCENERY: Explore the world with high-definition satellite terrain and height maps in stunning 3D. This is global flight simulation at its finest.
ENGAGE IN GLOBAL MULTIPLAYER MODES
• Join hundreds of other pilots and fly together in any part of the world.
• Chat with fellow multiplayer pilots, participate in weekly events, and join Virtual Airlines (VA) to earn Flight Points. RFS is the premier multiplayer flight simulator.
ATC MODE: BECOME AN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER
• ATC GAME MODE: Organize aircraft traffic, give instructions, and guide planes to fly safely.
• Enjoy interactive multi-voice ATC procedures and communications. Experience the dual role of pilot and controller in one simulation.
CREATE AND SHARE YOUR AVIATION PASSION
• CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLANE: Design your own airplane liveries and share them globally.
• DESIGN YOUR AIRPORT: Model your favorite HD airport, and watch other pilots take off from your creation in the flight simulator.
• PLANE SPOTTING: Capture your favorite planes. Experience city lights at night and the ethereal play of light and clouds during sunrise and sunset.
• Join the Real Flight Simulator community, discover new flight routes, and interact with aviation enthusiasts.
REAL-TIME SIMULATION REQUIREMENTS
Internet Connection is required for the full scope of aviation experiences and multiplayer features.
GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!
Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!
TERMS OF USE: https://www.rortos.com/terms-of-use/
Support: rfs@rortos.com

# iWriter Pro is elegant and minimalist text editor with built-in Markdown support. Distraction-free and subscription-free.
## Features:
- Clean and minimal interface.
- iCloud sync across iPad, iPhone, and Mac¹ devices. 
- Text editing with live Markdown syntax highlighting.
- HTML Preview for Markdown and MultiMarkdown documents.
- Typewriter mode² with focusing on line, sentence, or paragraph.
- Powerful Document Browser³ with tags support.
- Integrated counters for words, symbols, sentences, and paragraphs.
- Fast and responsive editing even for large files.
## iWriter Pro supports:
- Highlighting and rendering of LaTeX equations.
- Flowchart and Mermaid diagrams.
- Source code highlight in HTML preview.
- Exporting documents as HTML, PDF, RTF, EPUB, LaTeX, and DOCX. 
- Keyboard shortcuts⁴ for text formatting and quick navigation.
- Search and Replace in your documents.
- Light and dark layouts (auto-switching included).
- Automatic number/bullet/task list formatting.
¹ - iWriter Pro for Mac is available as a separate purchase on the Mac App Store.
² - Typewriter and Focus modes are available only on iPad.
³ - Editing files in Dropbox, Google Drive, and other 3d-party storage providers is not guaranteed.
⁴ - External keyboard is required.

bluejetty:00023745:ios.description:
Call bingo at home with a real voice. Bingo Caller replaces the bingo machine: tap to call the next ball, or let it call on its own every 3 to 60 seconds. Every ball is read out with its classic call – "two little ducks, twenty-two" – in a male or female voice.
SHOW THE BOARD ON YOUR TV
Use AirPlay or screen mirroring to put the full board, the last ball and the pattern on your TV, so the whole room can follow along.
PRINT YOUR OWN CARDS
Print numbered bingo cards (1, 2 or 4 to a page), or play a card on your phone. When someone shouts bingo, type in their card number and the app checks it against the called numbers.
75 PATTERNS
Lines, four corners, X, blackout, the Christmas tree and more. Turn on "Only Call Needed Letters" and the caller skips the letters your pattern can't use.
BIG SCREENS
On iPad and iPhone Duo, the call list and the full board sit side by side.
Perfect for family nights, parties, pub quizzes, classrooms and care homes.
Bingo Caller Pro (optional subscription) unlocks the TV display, unlimited automatic calling, all 75 patterns and unlimited card printing.

bluejetty:00114956:ios.name: Grow Therapy
bluejetty:00114956:ios.summary: Welcome to Grow Therapy – mental health care that’s easy to start, covered by insurance, and flexible enough to grow with your life. Whether you're working through anxiety, stress, burnout, relationships, or life’s ups and downs, Grow helps
bluejetty:00114956:ios.description:
Welcome to Grow Therapy – mental health care that’s easy to start, covered by insurance, and flexible enough to grow with your life. Whether you're working through anxiety, stress, burnout, relationships, or life’s ups and downs, Grow helps you find the right provider, book quickly, and stay supported before, during, and after your sessions.
With over 1 million clients served and 10 million+ sessions delivered, Grow has built trust the old-fashioned way – one session at a time. Now with the Grow Therapy app, your care can move with you. Because life doesn’t pause between sessions, and now, neither does your care.
The support you need. The way you need it.
* Therapy that fits your schedule: Evenings, weekends, no waitlists
* Thousands of therapists who get you: Search by identity, specialty, language, and more
* Covered by insurance: 100+ plans accepted—some sessions cost as little as $0
* Clear cost estimates: No subscriptions. No hidden fees
* All-in-one care: Therapy and medication support in one place
Say hello to coach
At the heart of the Grow app is coach, a conversational AI tool built specifically to support your mental health between sessions.
With more than one-third* of Americans already comfortable using AI for mental health support, we wanted to build an alternative that keeps a clinician’s expertise and training front and center. Most AI tools aren’t designed for therapy and they don’t integrate with your provider. We built coach to be different. Grow’s coach is an AI-powered, guided support tool built with clinical input, privacy, and safety at its core. It’s designed to help you reflect, build on your sessions, and keep growing between visits. Grow’s coach is fine-tuned to complement your care, not replace it, working in alignment with your provider and care plan, never independently.
Do the work with your therapist.
Practice it between sessions with coach.
The Grow App: Stay connected and supported—anytime, anywhere.
Book and join sessions, message your provider, and grow between visits with guided support, reflection, and practice from coach.
Here’s what you can do in the app:
* Book and join sessions in one tap
* Message your provider anytime, securely
* Use pre-session check-ins and post-session tools to stay on track
* Get guided support between sessions with coach
* Access handouts, worksheets, and therapy tools
* Track your progress with session insights and reminders
* Manage therapy and medication in one place
The Grow app brings therapy into real life. Whether you’re prepping for a session, navigating a tough moment, or reflecting on progress, your care stays with you, wherever you are.
Feeling better starts easier at Grow. Download Grow Therapy and take the first step.
Note: coach is available to eligible clients in select U.S. states. Grow’s coach is AI-powered and designed to support you between sessions. It doesn't replace therapy, isn't monitored in real time, and isn't a crisis tool. Grow’s coach is not a replacement for any medical diagnosis or treatments; likewise, it cannot, and does not intend to, provide medical advice or diagnosis. If you’re in a crisis or emergency, call 988 or 911.
CONNECT WITH US!
We’re always happy to hear from you! 
Check out our website: growtherapy.com
Follow us on TikTok: tiktok.com/@growtherapy
Follow us on Instagram: instagram.com/growtherapy
Like us on Facebook: facebook.com/joingrowtherapy
* Bansal, Bhavika. “Can an AI Chatbot Be Your Therapist? A Third of Americans Are Comfortable With the Idea.” YouGov, May 17, 2024.

bluejetty:00183609:ios.developer: The National Bank of Ras Al-Khaimah (P.S.C)
bluejetty:00183609:ios.summary:
Skip the hassle with easier school payments.
Skiply is a mobile payment service powered by RAKBANK that allows parents to make secured payments to schools in UAE with any bank Card. Skiply features include; tuition fee, uniforms, transpor
bluejetty:00183609:ios.description:
Skip the hassle with easier school payments.
Skiply is a mobile payment service powered by RAKBANK that allows parents to make secured payments to schools in UAE with any bank Card. Skiply features include; tuition fee, uniforms, transportation, books payments using a mobile app, signed permission slips for events, email receipts, multiple card support, and much more.
Making school payments have never been this easy, say Goodbye to waiting in queues to pay for your Childs’s school fee. Good enough? What if we say, School books for your child is just a login away, ready to get started? Download the app and skip quickly through the long waiting queues.
The interface is well-designed and straightforward with impressive offers and push notifications, reminding you of when payments are due. 
Here are some of Skiply’s features:
Seamless user registration, student registration, product catalogue for your school, notifications, order management, Online payment and offers, Email receipts, Multiple card support and much more to explore! 
With Skiply you can:
• Discover all the schools near your location.
• Pay online: users can pay off the school products ahead of time, then collect the products or have it delivered to your home.
• Parents can pay online for student events arranged by school and sign school permission slip digitally 
• Create a free MasterPass account: Skiply uses MasterPass, MasterCard’s secure digital wallet solution that accepts MasterCard and Visa. 
• The Apple Pay/Samsung pay/Google pay checkout option is coming later this year.
• Access your eReceipts: now you can easily review your Skiply transaction history in the app.
Once you select the school, the app checks for the students registered for that school, Once you click add student you will see your child’s details. Confirm and you are now ready to start exploring the school’s catalogue and make payments for your child’s school needs.
You can pay using one of your uploaded payment cards whenever you like. That means you can skip quickly to completion without having to visit the school and spend your precious time waiting in queues.
The great thing about Skiply is that family members and guardians who have the app can also use it to pay. All family members will have access to the transaction history.
Thanks to Skiply, the payment outstanding is cleared the minute the payment is successfully completed. 
Is my payment secure? Can someone see my card details? Is it safe to save my card in the Skiply wallet? 
Well worry no more, the technology provides a single digital storage place for all your payment and shipping information, and encrypts it to keep it out of harm’s way. When you make an online purchase, you simply use the digitally secure checkout option and your payment is processed using the information you have stored.

- Smart view PDF Reader for study & businesses: loading and display of PDF files quickly even with large PDF files.

bluejetty:00026982:ios.name: RadarScope
bluejetty:00026982:ios.summary: RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products.
bluejetty:00026982:ios.description:
RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products. Your initial purchase provides professional radar visualization in a fully native app, free from distracting and invasive practices, with optional subscription packages to add even more capabilities.
Whether you’re scanning for a mesocyclone’s tell-tale hook echo, pinpointing the landfall of a hurricane’s eye wall, or identifying velocity couplet, hail spike, or debris ball signatures, RadarScope displays native radar data in its original radial format. You see what the radar sees almost as soon as the radar sees it, with automatic updates every two to ten minutes depending on the radar’s scanning strategy.
Your initial app purchase includes the following:
• Full suite of single-site radar products for the US, Canada, Guam, Denmark, Finland, and Germany
• 10-frame radar loops
• Two built-in providers for radar data
• Tornado, thunderstorm, flash flood, marine, snow squall, extreme wind, tropical, and other warnings in the US
• Selected severe weather warnings in Canada and Australia
• Severe weather watches in the US and Canada
• NWS-generated storm tracks with hail, TVS, and mesocyclone attributes
• Inspector and distance tools
• Color palette options for radar data
• Weather Pulse data plan integration
• Spotter Network integration for storm and location reporting
• mPING integration for submitting weather reports to NSSL
• Bundled maps with political borders, water bodies, and highways, optimized for low-bandwidth use
• Support for widgets and complications
• Universal app for Apple platforms, including Apple Watch, and Apple TV
• CarPlay support
• Family Sharing support
RadarScope Pro Tier One is an optional annual subscription that adds more features for tracking severe weather:
• 30-frame radar loops
• Cloud-to-ground lightning strikes
• Special weather statements in the US and Canada
• Mesoscale convective and precipitation discussions
• SPC convective, tornado, hail, wind, and fire outlooks
• WPC excessive rainfall outlooks in the US
• Local storm reports in the US
• Custom color palette support
• Multi-pane display (2 on phones; 4 on larger devices)
• Family Sharing support
RadarScope Pro Tier Two is an optional annual or monthly subscription that transforms RadarScope into a more complete visualization tool for a larger suite of weather products, including:
• Everything in Pro Tier One
• 50-frame radar loops
• A third provider for US radar data
• 30-year archive of NEXRAD Level II radar data
• 6-year archive of NEXRAD Level III data
• 30-day archive of super-res and non-US radar data
• 20-year archive of NWS bulletins
• GOES satellite data
• Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) data
• Real-Time Mesoscale Assimilation (RTMA) data
• GFS, ECMWF, HRRR, HRW, NAM, and RRFS model data
• Surface observations
• ProbSevere layer
• Atmospheric soundings in the US
• Hail size, hail probability, and azimuthal shear contours with a 30-day archive
• More detailed transportation and satellite imagery maps
• Custom color palette support for GOES, MRMS, RTMA, and forecast products
• Server-sent events for radar and warning updates
• Cross-platform subscription sharing on up to 5 devices
If you choose to buy a RadarScope Pro subscription, it will be charged to your App Store account. The subscription will be auto-renewed within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price you originally paid. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal disabled via your App Store account settings after the purchase. Once purchased, the subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period.
DTN is committed to safeguarding your privacy online. Our privacy policy is available for review at https://www.dtn.com/privacy-policy/
Please visit our web site for more information.

bluejetty:00073046:ios.description:
Tavern Rumble is a Free Strategy Roguelike Deckbuilding Card Games
Start your adventure with basic mercenary cards, fight your way up, get loot and strengthen your deck to fight strong Bosses along the way.
Discover synergies between each cards. A card might be useless on their own, but use it along with others and it can be your most powerful arsenal.
Roguelike element: For those who are not familiar with is a game with random dungeon, loot, mercenary, monsters and most importantly permanent death.
So each run will be somewhat new experiences and not tied-up with your previous runs.
Do you have what it takes to reach the Endgame?
Craft a unique deck never encountered in other card games, encounter bizarre creatures, take blessings of unimaginable power, Slay monsters, escape the spire loop!
March forward into a deep quest and stop wandering alone in the darkest night.
It is like having a dream to become the legendary monster slayer Hero that embark on a journey in the middle of nowhere to fulfill a hollow prophecy from a prophet.
Don't let your power starve consume you!
Features:
- Perfect card games to play on your 30 minutes coffee break
- Each playable Classes provides 100+ cards that you can choose through your gameplay
- Cute simple pixelart sprites
- Easy to learn, Hard to master
- Recruit legendary Heroes cards and fight alongside them. To arms!!
- Play offline without internet connection
- Absolutely Free to Play
Available Classes: 
+ Knights of Pentagon: Strong Knights with balance offense and defense
+ Hunter Guild: Master of poison, card draw and discard effects. Rise and use Shadows to fight your enemies!
+ Roughrock Clan: Self damaging units, Team Buffs and strong independent Units.
+ Land of the Dead: Army of Undeads. With help of Hades and friends, fight against the darkness within your shell.
+ Transylvania Family: Bloodsucker Dracula and Vampire alike
+ Magick Academy : Using magic to summon powerful being or destroy monsters directly
+ Void Community : Hire mercenary that consists of Ninja and Thief. Watch your back!
+ Steampunk City : Block incoming damage and use powerful Robot to attack
The game is still on development and we are still actively working on new contents.
What are you waiting for, it's Free
Download and Play now !

bluejetty:00034638:ios.description:
Introducing Vocal Remover AI, an application that redefines the boundaries of audio processing. This app is an all-in-one solution for your music & vocal extracting and editing needs, boasting an array of features that are both powerful and easy to use. 
Create backing track and karaoke for any song in a couple of taps! Also our app can easily cope with the extraction of musical instruments from a track - it splits the uploaded file into several tracks.
What is our Vocal Remover AI for?
⌘ REMOVE VOCAL
With advanced AI algorithms, it can isolate and remove vocals from any track, leaving you with a clean instrumental version. This feature is perfect for singers, DJs, producers, and musicians alike.
⌘ CREATE STEMS
This feature allows you to deconstruct any song into its individual components quickly and effortlessly. Whether you need to isolate the bass, drums, or any other element, our app makes it simple
⌘ MAKE ACAPELLA
With just a few taps, you can create stunning and HQ acapella tracks from any song in your library. It's never been easier to let your voice shine.
⌘ RECORD YOUR VOICE TO THE BACKING SOUND
You can record your vocals to any created backing track. We also added the possibility to hear yourself in headphones while recording.
⌘ CHANGE VOLUME & PAN
Fine-tune the balance and stereo field of your tracks with precision. You can get a better sound by tweaking the volume and pan without needing additional audio editing apps.
⌘ ADJUST PITCH & SPEED
Alter the tonality and tempo of any song. Whether you're practicing a piece in a different key or slowing down a track to learn it, this feature is a valuable tool for any musician.
⌘ DETECT BPM & KEY
Instantly analyze any track to reveal its tempo (BPM) and musical key. This feature is essential for musicians looking to practice or remix in the correct key, and producers needing to match tracks effortlessly.
⌘ RECOGNIZE CHORDS
Try our AI chord recognition - upload a track and instantly see the chord names, fingering, and hand placement on both piano and guitar. This feature lets you learn the chords to any song — and even start playing with zero musical background!
⌘ ADD EFFECTS
Make your track unique and perfect - add any of the sound effects presented in the app: gain, reverb, delay, audio filters.
⌘ RECORD VIDEO
Record your own performance with ease. After splitting a track into individual stems—such as vocals and instruments—you can choose exactly which parts to keep and record a video alongside them. Sing along, play your instrument, or create your own version of the track while staying perfectly in sync. Once you’re done, export your performance as a high-quality MP4 video ready to share. 
⌘ MAKE PLAYLISTS
No need to use other apps - create and edit playlists right here! You can even set the cover image and playback order.
⌘ SHARE & EXPORT
Save the result in various formats. The results can be stored in projects, shared and saved to the device.
⌘ SAVE YOUR TIME
Despite its robust feature set, our app remains user-friendly. You do not need to deal with the application for a long time or look for something extra. It’s easy for anyone to use, regardless of their audio editing experience. 
With Vocal Remover AI, professional-grade vocal & music extracting is just a few taps away. Pulling a voice or any instrument from a track is now a breeze!
-------------------------------
* Some features available only with Subscription.

bluejetty:00154289:ios.description:
Quit Vaping. No Crutches. No Guilt. Just Clarity. This isn’t a willpower app, and it’s definitely not a guilt-based one.
JAX helps you quit vaping by changing how you see nicotine — not by asking you to fight yourself every day. There’s no shame, no scare tactics, and no pressure to be “strong enough.” Just clear insight, momentum, and a surprisingly enjoyable way to walk away for good.
You’ll track progress to see how far you’ve come, not to judge yourself, and move through a program designed to make quitting feel lighter, simpler, and finally doable.
A Gamified Experience That Actually Makes Sense
Each short session unlocks the next, guiding you through the psychology behind vaping and why quitting is far easier than most people are told. No fluff. No lectures. Just sharp insights that click — and stick.
A Coach Built to Be Relatable
Meet JAX: an ai coach who is direct, supportive, occasionally sarcastic, and always on your side. No robotic advice or generic motivational quotes. Just clear guidance that cuts through the noise and helps you see vaping for what it really is.
Support When Cravings Hit
When the urge shows up, so does the help. Fast, focused tools designed for the moment — often with humor — so cravings lose their power instead of turning into a battle.
Real Momentum You Can Feel
Milestones, streaks, and visible progress keep things moving forward. You’re not “trying to quit.” You’re actively leveling up and leaving something behind.
No Substitutes. No Gimmicks.
No patches, gums, or distractions pretending to fix the problem. The goal is simple: once nicotine loses its appeal, quitting stops feeling like a struggle.
The 90-Day Recovery Module
Quitting is only part of the journey. Staying free is where confidence is built. The Recovery Module is a 90-day follow-through program designed to keep you grounded after you’ve stopped vaping. It helps reinforce new habits, prevent backsliding, and strengthen the mindset that makes relapse unnecessary — without obsessing over “staying quit.” Think of it as stability, not restriction. Support without pressure. Progress without fear.
Built for People Who Are Done Struggling
If you’ve tried to quit before and it didn’t last, it’s not because you lacked discipline. You were never shown the full picture. JAX doesn’t teach you how to resist nicotine. It helps you understand why you may not need it. Once that clicks, quitting stops being a fight, and freedom can feel natural.

bluejetty:00174750:ios.summary:
Unlock the full potential of your Philips HomeRun robot. Tell it exactly how and when to clean each room and mow your lawn. Then, relax.
With the Philips HomeRun Robot app you can:

● Mak
bluejetty:00174750:ios.description:
Unlock the full potential of your Philips HomeRun robot. Tell it exactly how and when to clean each room and mow your lawn. Then, relax.
With the Philips HomeRun Robot app you can:
● Start, pause or stop cleaning and mowing remotely
● Make a precise map of your home to clean each room in no time
● Control where your robot cleans and mows
● Choose a cleaning mode per room and mowing mode per lawn
● Set up once, enjoy spotless floors and lawns daily
● Custom clean and mow for specific situations
● Receive progress updates on each clean and mow
● Keep your data secure
Start, pause or stop your robot remotely
Come home to clean floors and a perfect-looking garden every day by using your Philips HomeRun vacuum, mop, and lawn mowing robot in combination with the app. Set it up once—to clean each room and mow your lawn just the way you like it—touch ‘Start’, anytime, anywhere, and let your robot do the rest.
On its first run, your robot will map your floor plan and garden. Now you have an interactive map of your home that you can use to tell your robot how and when to clean each room or to monitor how your lawn is mowed. The robot vacuum cleaner can store up to five maps.
Control where your robot vacuum cleaner cleans
Only want your robot to clean the kitchen, bathroom, living room? With the app, you can tell your robot which rooms you want cleaned, and in what order. If there are areas or things you’d like it to avoid—like precious items or a rug in an area you want to mop—you can tell it where not to go, or not to mop, as well.
Choose a cleaning mode for each room and mowing mode for each lawn
Give each room unique attention with one of the cleaning modes and mowing modes for your lawn. Use Dry mode to vacuum the bedroom and Wet & Dry mode to vacuum and mop hard floors. Put your robot on Quiet mode if, say, you have a meeting, or give the kitchen an extra thorough clean by using Intensive mode. Choose a mowing mode for your lawn to get the perfect looking garden.
Set up once. Enjoy spotless floors and lawns every day
Once you’ve created a cleaning and mowing plan, clean floors and perfectly mowed lawns are always a tap away. Tap ‘Start’ when you want your robot to begin - every day if you like, and at a time that suits your schedule.
Custom clean for specific situations
Had friends over and need an extra thorough clean? Or maybe the dog left paw prints in your hallway. Again. Schedule a custom clean and mow that targets specific rooms, areas.
Get step-by-step guidance to setup easily
From connecting to Wi-Fi to the first clean and mow, we’ll guide you through every step of getting started. You’ll find easy-to-follow instructions and how-to-videos as well.
Always have support at your fingertips
Have extra questions about the HomeRun app and robot? You’ll find a user manual in the app, answers to FAQs and easy access to Customer Care if need be.
Receive progress updates
As your robot cleans and mows, you’ll receive in-app updates. See where your robot currently is in your home and what the robot mowing progress is in your garden. Check on its battery levels and, most importantly, get notified as soon as the cleaning run or mowing is done 
Maintain high performance
Get the best performance from your robot by replacing parts on time. Our app lets you know when it’s time to replace parts like filters, mops, and blades, and makes it easy to order them.
Keep your data secure
Philips adheres to a strict privacy policy. We recommend creating an account to ensure you can save your preferences. If you prefer, you can use the app as a guest. 
WiFi
Philips HomeRun robot vacuum cleaners have dual band Wi-Fi so they are easy to connect to your home Wi-Fi, whether it's to 2.4 or 5.0GHz. Robot lawn mowers only connect to your 2.4GHz home Wi-Fi.
Need help?
Visit www.Philips.com to find answers to our most frequently asked questions, or get in touch with our Consumer Care team.

bluejetty:00129407:ios.description:
Fun and easy self-assessment for adult ADHD. Based on a science-proven ASRS-v1.1 symptom checklist. 
The science behind it:
**The Value of Screening for Adults With ADHD**
Research suggests that the symptoms of ADHD can persist into adulthood, having a significant impact on the relationships, careers, and even the personal safety of your patients who may suffer from it. Because this disorder is often misunderstood, many people who have it do not receive appropriate treatment and, as a result, may never reach their full potential. Part of the problem is that it can be difficult to diagnose, particularly in adults.
The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-v1.1) Symptom Checklist was developed in conjunction with the World Health Organization (WHO), and the Workgroup on Adult
ADHD. 
The Symptom Checklist is an instrument consisting of the eighteen DSM-IV-TR criteria. Six of the eighteen questions were found to be the most predictive of symptoms consistent with ADHD. These six questions are the basis for the ASRS v1.1 Screener and are also Part A of the Symptom Checklist. Part B of the Symptom Checklist contains the remaining twelve questions.
How Accurate Is It?
This quiz is NOT a diagnostic tool. Mental health disorders can only be diagnosed by qualified mental health professionals.

bluejetty:00125899:ios.description:
A peaceful narrative experience, in which the only objective is to satisfy your curiosity.
Explore an ocean dream world, in which time passes even when you are not there, visit forgotten islands and piece together memories – some even existing beyond the screen of your device.
“The Sailor’s Dream is a novella, a folk EP, and an art installation wrapped into one app ... It’s an inspired example of what storytelling can be in the 21st century and the way modern technology can shine new light on well-worn conventions.” - A.V. Club
“Its lonely, bittersweet tale—told in a wonderfully unique mix of approaches—is the best storytelling I've ever played on my iPad.” - Kotaku
“It's an experience that's entirely about the narrative, but one uniquely built for smartphones and tablets. The peaceful visuals, the wonderful music, the sharp writing, and the simple interactive toys all go towards creating an atmosphere and telling a story.” - The Verge
“... you can easily wander for hours through The Sailor’s Dream making music, playing it not like a game, but as an instrument ... If you are looking for a space to contemplate, a place to linger, a path to walk in patient consideration, you will find yourself at home in The Sailor’s Dream for quite some time.” - Kill Screen
“A world-in-miniature put in the palm of your hands, which rewards you for your exploration of it with sensory delight. And perhaps most powerfully of all, pushes you to feel deeply for its inhabitants.” - Gamezebo

bluejetty:00025281:android.name: PlantCam: AI Plant Identifier
bluejetty:00025281:android.summary: Need help identifying a plant? With the PlantCam identifier app, you can quickly and easily identify plants, flowers, and weeds. Plus, you'll get tips on plant care and disease diagnosis. The app even has a light meter to help you find the
bluejetty:00025281:android.description:
Need help identifying a plant? With the PlantCam identifier app, you can quickly and easily identify plants, flowers, and weeds. Plus, you'll get tips on plant care and disease diagnosis. The app even has a light meter to help you find the perfect spot for your plants. Best of all, the app's database of 100,000+ plants is constantly growing.
Plant identification:
PlantCam makes the art of plant identification as simple as point and shoot. Capture a photo or input the characteristics, and let PlantCam do the rest. With an impressive 98% accuracy rate, our app enables you to identify anything from vibrant flowers, towering trees, common weeds, exotic cacti and succulents, to elegant ferns and conifers. Instant identification is just a photo away!
Plant Doctor
Introducing your new gardening assistant, the AI Plant Doctor! Ask anything about your plants, from identification to care tips and even disease diagnosis. This unique feature empowers you to nurture a thriving garden with AI-backed expertise.
Care tips:
Plant care is no longer a guessing game! Learn quickly about the different species in your garden and their specific needs. From sunlight preference, ideal soil type, to watering frequency, our app provides valuable insights that lead to healthier plants.
Timely Reminders:
Never forget to water your plants again! Get timely push notifications that ensure you nourish your plants on time, keeping them healthy and thriving.
Plant Disease Diagnosis:
Keeping plants healthy is a tough job! Luckily, PlantCam uses AI to diagnose common pests and diseases, making it easy for even novice gardeners to understand what might be going wrong in their gardens.
Light Meter:
Ensure your plants are receiving the ideal light levels with our built-in light meter. It's like having a personal sun guide for your plants.
Advanced plants search:
Finding the perfect plant to complement your space has never been easier. Our comprehensive database, sourced globally, suits various environments. Be it an indoor succulent or an outdoor fern, PlantCam helps you find the perfect fit.
PlantCam is your ultimate companion for an enriching journey into the natural world. Designed for all green thumbs - whether a beginner or a seasoned pro, PlantCam is here to enhance your understanding of the plants around you. Download now, and start blossoming with PlantCam!

bluejetty:00099676:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00099676:ios.description:
Elyplay: Obby & Mini Games is your all-in-one hub for fun, fast, and browser-style play. With more than 1,000 creative maps and mini games, you can jump into action instantly with quick loading and no long setup.
This mobile game is designed for quick sessions and smooth obby gameplay. Whether you want to race, build, solve puzzles, or hang out in social hubs, Elyplay offers endless ways to play. It’s also an avatar game where you customize outfits, unlock pets, and express yourself in a growing community.
GAME MODES & HIGHLIGHTS
Obby & Parkour
Try exciting obby games, climb through tricky parkour maps, and master challenges like “the floor is lava.” Each run is a test of skill and reaction.
Tycoon & Simulator
Manage businesses, create factories, and grow resources in interactive tycoon maps inside this browser-style world.
Escape Maps
Take on logic and survival tests with escape-prison scenarios, clever prison-escape puzzles, and even the infamous Barry’s Prison. Strategy and timing decide your success.
Arcade Runners
Push your limits in speed-focused obby challenge maps. Perfect for short bursts of fun between tasks.
Role-Play & Avatar Customization
Enjoy immersive role-play with cafés, homes, and social spaces. Make your mark with outfits, hats, and emotes.
Horror Maps
Dark adventures for thrill seekers. Navigate spooky obby 3D stages with limited light and sudden scares.
Puzzle & Brain Games
Quick and fun logic challenges—from math sequences to memory stages—built for instant play.
Creative Obby World
Explore an open obby world where players share their own maps. Build, play, and test yourself in endless obstacle-course games.
WHY ELYPLAY STANDS OUT
• Instant play inside the app
• Lightweight, fast loading (often under 5 seconds)
• Daily rewards and unlockable items
• Weekly updates with new 3D maps and events
• Missions and quests with coins and prizes
BEST FOR
• Fans of Easy Obby maps and quick challenges
• Players who love themed levels like escape school obby
• Anyone looking for fast mobile games
• Builders, creators, and fans of obstacle-course games
Download Elyplay: Obby & Mini Games today and start exploring. Play obby challenge maps, earn rewards, and unlock new adventures every week in this ultimate browser-style hub.

bluejetty:00085943:ios.name: SpendMon - Expense Tracker
bluejetty:00085943:ios.summary:
A simple expense tracker and budget book for keeping up with what you spend each month!
• Every feature, no payment
Statistics, themes and backups are all included — nothing is locked behind a payment.
• Three-second entry, no categories
bluejetty:00085943:ios.description:
A simple expense tracker and budget book for keeping up with what you spend each month!
• Every feature, no payment
Statistics, themes and backups are all included — nothing is locked behind a payment.
• Three-second entry, no categories
Just enter the date, the amount and a note. There are no categories to pick or sort through, so you can log a purchase the moment you make it. Save the bills you pay every month as recurring entries.
• Home screen widgets
See this month's spending, your daily average and the projected total for the month without opening the app.
• Pick your favorite theme
Make the tracker your own with four themes: mint, pink, brown, and navy.
• Yearly spending statistics
Compare every month on a chart and see at a glance how much the year has added up to.
• Backup without an account
Export a backup file and load it back later — no sign-up, no login. CSV export is supported too.
• Search and see totals
Type a word and the app finds every matching entry — with the total added up for you. Set a start and end date to see just that period.
• Easy to read at a glance
Sort by date or amount, browse month by month, see the day of the week, choose a currency, and lock the screen.

bluejetty:00184820:ios.description:
Shakes & Fidget – The Award-Winning Fantasy Role-Playing Game:
Starting as a browser game, you can now play Shakes & Fidget on the go! Join the MMORPG world with millions of players and conquer the medieval world with your unique hero. Download and play the fun, satirical, epic multiplayer role-playing game full of adventures, magic, dungeons, legendary monsters, and epic quests today! One of the top role-playing games with multiplayer PVP and AFK modes from Germany!
FUNNY COMIC CHARACTERS
Create and customize your own medieval SF comic character. Meet various characters on your journey, experience crazy adventures, complete epic quests, and earn rewards to reach the top spot in the Hall of Fame! Each character has a unique style – choose your RPG hero strategically to become a legend. Real online players stand between you and your victory in the multiplayer PVP arena.
EXPERIENCE EPIC QUESTS
Prepare your weapons to fight powerful quests against fantasy monsters with your comic hero. In the tavern, you will meet special characters looking for heroes to go on quests for rewards! Ensure your hero is equipped with the best weapons and armor to battle mighty beasts. Character stats and strategy play a crucial role in quests! Be brave and march on!
BUILD YOUR FORTRESS
A fortress allows you to mine powerful gems and train soldiers, archers, and mages. Strategically build various aspects of your fortress to reap the best rewards. Protect your fortress from enemy attacks!
FORM YOUR GUILD
Together with your guildmates, you become stronger, invincible, and find lots of epic loot! Take on quests, experience exciting adventures, level up, collect gold, gain honor, become overpowered, and with some strategy, become a living medieval legend!
MULTIPLAYER PVP
Fight other players in guild battles or the arena, whether solo or AFK. In this role-playing game, many talented online players are waiting to defeat you. Stay vigilant, young hero!
Play the free MMORPG Shakes & Fidget and look forward to:
* Unique comic look with animated humor
* Thousands of medieval weapons and epic gear
* PVE solo and with friends, as well as multiplayer PVP against other players
* Exciting quests and creepy dungeons
* Free-to-play and regular updates

bluejetty:00065711:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00065711:ios.description:
Eat with confidence. Scan any food in seconds.
Spoonful is the food scanner built for people with real dietary needs — whether you're managing IBS, celiac disease, food allergies, or following a plant-based lifestyle. Just scan a barcode or snap a photo, and Spoonful instantly tells you if a product is safe for your diet.
No more squinting at ingredient labels. No more guesswork at the grocery store.
--
SCAN ANY PRODUCT INSTANTLY
Point your camera at a barcode and get a clear green, yellow, or red result in seconds. Spoonful analyzes not just the obvious ingredients — but the hidden ones too.
LOW FODMAP
Get simple traffic-light results based on a product's FODMAP content. Supports all phases — elimination, reintroduction, and personalization — and reviewed by Monash-trained dietitians who manage IBS for thousands of patients.
GLUTEN FREE
Detects both obvious and hidden gluten ingredients in packaged foods, including potential cross-contact risks like oats. Reviewed by dietitians who personally live with celiac disease.
ALLERGEN SCANNER
Covers milk, fish, shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, soy, and eggs. Goes beyond the label to flag cross-contact risks that other apps miss.
PLANT-BASED
Options for vegan, vegetarian, and pescatarian diets. Catches hidden animal-derived ingredients you'd never think to look for. Reviewed by plant-based dietitians.
--
FIND BETTER ALTERNATIVES
When a product doesn't work for your diet, Spoonful doesn't just say no — it finds you the best substitutes based on taste and popularity, so you never have to leave the store empty-handed.
COMMUNITY-POWERED
Browse thousands of products scanned and reviewed by real people following the same diets as you. You're not figuring this out alone.
Spoonful is trusted by people managing some of the most complex dietary needs out there. We're grounded in Food as Medicine — because what you eat has a direct impact on how you feel every day.
Join the community and start shopping with confidence.
Privacy Policy: https://spoonfulapp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00086447:ios.description:
Your personal AI language tutor - available 24/7, endlessly patient, and obsessed with getting you fluent.
Langotalk is the fastest way to go from knowing a few words to holding a real conversation. It works the way a real tutor does: listening to how you speak, catching your mistakes, and building each session around exactly where you are right now.
WHAT MAKES LANGOTALK DIFFERENT
Every session is shaped around your specific grammar gaps, pronunciation patterns, and vocabulary weak spots — and your tutor remembers all of it, session after session.
The moment you make a mistake, you'll understand why - and your tutor will keep revisiting that pattern until it sticks.
HOW IT WORKS
Open the app and start a conversation in your target language. Speak or type - your AI tutor listens, responds naturally, and gives you real-time grammar and pronunciation correction. After each session, your tutor updates its picture of where you are and plans what to work on next. You never have to figure out what to study. Langotalk maps your gaps and leads you step by step.
FEATURES
- Personalized AI tutor that adapts to your level after every sentence
- Real-time grammar and pronunciation correction with clear explanations
- Voice and text conversation practice on any topic you choose
- Memory across sessions — your tutor always knows where you left off
- Stress-free practice available anytime, with zero judgment
- Progress tracking so you can see how far you've come
20+ languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Arabic, Dutch, Portuguese, Korean, and Mandarin
WHAT LEARNERS SAY
"I've tried learning French for years. This is the first time I'm actually speaking full sentences." — Emma, UK
"It's not random practice. It's real dialogue, real feedback, and drills based on what I personally mess up." — Sarah, Canada

bluejetty:00122321:ios.description:
Welcome to Wimbledon 2026 — the official app of The Championships.
Your personal companion to the iconic moments, world-class tennis, and the unmistakable
atmosphere of Wimbledon, the only Grand Slam played on grass, live from the All England Lawn
Tennis Club, London.
From the first serve of Qualifying on 22 June to the final point on 12 July, stay connected to every
moment of the action. Follow every serve, rally, and result with real-time scores, live updates,
and immersive features that bring you closer to the action, wherever you are.
Key Features:
- LIVE Scores & Stats – Real-time updates from every match on every court, including
Qualifying and the main draw.
- Live Likelihood to Win – See each player’s chances of victory, updated throughout the match.
- Match Chat – Ask questions and get instant insights with our AI-powered assistant.
- Stories & Moments – Immerse yourself in the best of Wimbledon with curated highlights and
behind-the-scenes content.
- Player Profiles – Track your favourites and explore their path to the final.
- LIVE Radio – Ball-by-ball commentary from Centre Court and No.1 Court, plus daily coverage.
- News & Video – Stay up to date with highlights, interviews, and exclusive features.
- Personalised Alerts – Receive updates tailored to your favourite players.
- Order of Play & Schedule – Plan your day with the latest match schedules.
- The Wimbledon Shop – Browse the Wimbledon Collection in the app.
myWimbledon Login
Register or log in to personalise your experience. Choose your favourite players or countries to
follow across devices. Required for digital ticket access.
Ticketing
Wimbledon ticket holders must use the app to display mobile tickets for entry, along with photo ID.

bluejetty:00152992:ios.description:
The Car Survival Rate is a realistic car crash test simulator where you can experience how different road scenarios affect vehicle. Starting from head-on collisions and rollovers to side impacts and crashes, test how cars can survive real traffic accidents.
Main Features:
- Realistic softbody physics. Cars can deform, crumple, break just like in real life. Our advanced softbody phycics system accurately simulates material behaviour in different crash and road conditions. 
- Real various road crash scenarios. Recreate real-world accidents: frontal collisions, breaking windows, rear-end impacts, highway pileups and T-bone crashes. See how vehicles would react in various scenarios. 
- Detailed vehicle damage. Every crash creates unique deformation. Parts fall off, frames bend, and tires blow out based on the force of the impact. 
- Multiple crash environments. Drive through highways, intersections, hills, mountains, bridges, and more. Each location offers different types of crashes and challenges.
- Stunning 3D graphics. The game graphics, textures and maps based on real-wold prototypes. 
- Easy controls and mobile optimization. The game provides clear interface and smooth performance on most devices. Jump right into testing without complex menus or tutorials.
What makes our game unique? 
- One of the most realistic car crash simulators with high quality graphics on mobile.
- Focused on testing car behavior in actual road situations.
- Ideal for fans of softbody destruction, crash tests, and vehicle physics.
- Regular updates and improvements based on community feedback.
Tips: 
The faster you go, the greater the damage.
Try different crash angles for more realistic results. 
Combine multiple vehicles in the same crash for massive wrecks.
Use different cars to see how size and weight affect damage
The more you damage your car, the more in-game money you earn. Use earnings to unlock new cars, maps and upgrades.
Summary. The game brings diverse crash scenarios based on real road situations. Including realistic vehicle physics and destruction mechanics with various vehicles to test, from compact cars to larger trucks. You coud test car on different maps, such as: mountain roads, canyons, highways, hills, broken bridges, etc.
We’re a very small team working hard for bringing realistic crash physics to mobile. Your feedback and reviews help us improve and grow the game.  Try it now and let us know what you think!

bluejetty:00066204:ios.summary:

Warm up your ears befo
bluejetty:00066204:ios.description:
Hear a chord, then build it yourself. No multiple choice: slide your finger until your note locks in with the others.
18 ear training games for intervals, chords, relative pitch, play by ear, sight reading and rhythm.
Warm up your ears before singing, band, orchestra, choir, guitar or piano practice.
Most ear trainers ask you to pick the right answer. Harmonize asks you to make it. A friendly shrimp plays the example; you slide your finger up and down the screen to bend your own note toward it. When it is slightly off you hear beats, a slow wobble in the sound. When the wobble disappears and the notes melt together, you have found it. No music theory needed.
■ New here? Start with the Tutorial
The Tutorial card on the home screen walks you through it: hold, slide, listen for the wobble, stop when it melts. The green button replays the example as often as you like.
■ Build the interval
- Double Stop: add a second note on top of a reference. Octave, perfect fifth, major third and more
- Chords: take one role inside a three-note chord and hold your part
- Moon: a slow, low-gravity version of Double Stop for advanced ears
- Low Register: the real bass range, so low that a phone speaker cannot reproduce the fundamental; you read the pitch from its overtones
- Drone: like a bagpipe, a drone sounds the whole time. Tune shifts and phrases over it, one note at a time, until the beating stops
- Trill: hold one finger down and press/lift with another. 6 fingerings x 36 exercises
■ Read the score
- Sight Reading: read the notes on the staff and answer on the two-row keyboard. The white keys are labeled with their note names, so you can count lines and spaces even if sheet music is new to you. 10 categories, 200 levels, 1,140 exercises
- Bass Clef: the same game on the bass staff, for bass guitar, cello and the piano's left hand
■ Rhythm
- Rhythm: tap along with the scrolling score
- Polyrhythm: two different pulses at once, one per hand
- Mimic Taiko: call and response on Japanese taiko drums. Hear a pattern, play it back
- Silent: the sound stops. Count the seconds in your head and tap at the right moment
■ Listen and remember
- Play by Ear: reproduce the melody you heard on the keyboard. 9 categories, 129 levels, 516 phrases
- Scales: hear a scale, then rebuild it one note at a time
- Arpeggios: hear a broken chord and pinpoint each chord tone
- Harmonics: a string's fundamental plays, then one of its overtones. Name the note it becomes
- Memory: a sound version of the classic card-matching game. Flip takoyaki (Japanese octopus balls) and find the two that ring alike
- Goldfish Scoop: a festival game from Japan. An example sound plays; scoop the swimming goldfish that sings in the same tone
■ Tools
- Weekly Challenge: 5 tasks that change every week, with the example played only once. 3 runs per week, ranked on a Game Center weekly leaderboard
- Metronome
- Tuner: live readout in cents through the mic
■ Under the hood
- 14 instrument sounds to choose from, plus 5 bass instruments for the Low Register stage
- Reference A from 440 to 446 Hz
- Note names in English, German, Japanese or Italian
- Rhythm games calibrate audio latency for your device
- Judged against just intonation, so it carries straight over to choir, wind band, orchestra and ensemble work
- Tutorial for first-timers
■ Made for
- Singers who want to stop drifting off pitch
- Anyone training relative pitch
- Players who want to pick up tunes by ear
- Musicians chasing that moment when your note locks into the chord
■ About ads and purchases
Free to start, with ads. Remove Ads is a one-time purchase that turns off both banner and full-screen ads. Extra content is also a one-time purchase; there is no monthly subscription. Reinstalled the app or switched devices? Tap Settings > Restore Purchases to bring your purchases back.
■ Languages
Japanese, English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)

bluejetty:00160741:android.description:
Muslim Daily is a streamlined Islamic application featuring a clean and intuitive interface, highly trusted by the global Muslim community. Designed for reliability, this app serves as the essential toolkit for Muslims to manage their religious duties with precision, anytime and anywhere.
We prioritize your prayer life by delivering instant, high-priority Athan alerts that ensure you never miss a sacred moment, even when your device is inactive.
🕌 Accurate Prayer Times & Athan Alerts Never miss a prayer with our high-precision location-based timing.
● To ensure you receive critical, real-time Athan reminders even when your screen is locked or you are using other apps, Muslim Daily requires the [USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT] permission. This guarantees the sacred call to prayer is delivered prominently and without delay.
📖 Quran Kareem Digital Quran with Audio – Read and listen to the Holy Quran with high-quality recitations from world-renowned Qaris. Supports multiple translations and offline access.
● Muslim Daily utilizes [FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK] to ensure uninterrupted Quranic audio play when you are multitasking or your screen is off.
🧭 Qibla Finder Precision Qibla Finder – A high-accuracy digital compass that instantly determines the direction of the Kaaba from any location.
📅 Hijri Calendar & Log Islamic Hijri Calendar – Provides the lunar calendar, upcoming prayer dates, and a personal log to record your daily prayer consistency.
🤲 Authentic Azkar Daily Supplications (Azkar) – A collection of authentic Duas and remembrances from the Quran and Hadiths for easy daily recitation.
📿 Digital Tasbih Smart Tasbih Counter – A simple and convenient electronic counter to help you keep an accurate count during Dhikr and prayers.
✨ 99 Names of Allah Asma-ul-Husna – Explore the 99 names of Allah with detailed meanings to deepen your spiritual knowledge and reflection.
Service Permission Transparency
To ensure the reliability of our religious services, Muslim Daily requires the following permissions. These are essential for the app to function correctly in the background:
● USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT: Crucial for delivering immediate and high-priority Athan alerts. This ensures prayer reminders are prominently displayed (including on lock screens) at the exact prayer time, preventing users from missing their obligatory prayers.
● FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK: Allows for the uninterrupted audio recitation of the Quran. This ensures recitations continue to play smoothly even when you switch apps or turn off your screen.
✉️ Questions?
If you have any questions, feel free to contact us via email: muslimdaily.feedback@gmail.com
❤️ Share and Recommend this Beautiful Muslim app for Android to your friends and family. May Allah bless us in this world and hereafter. ❤️

bluejetty:00121142:ios.description:
Welcome to The Daily Record, your go-to app for the biggest Scottish, UK and world news. Immerse yourself in the latest news, sport, entertainment and more. Keep up to date with the world of politics, find out what’s happening on your favourite TV shows and follow celebrity stories, all in one place. With our user-friendly interface and comprehensive coverage, you'll never need to go anywhere else.
What’s included?
Stay Informed:
Get the latest breaking news, compelling journalism and exclusive reporting at your fingertips. From the Senedd to traffic and travel updates, we've got you covered.
Breaking News Alerts:
Be the first to know about important news, updates and events with our real-time push notifications. From breaking news stories to traffic updates, we'll keep you informed and connected.
Personalised Content:
Customise your newsfeed based on your preferences and interests. Stay up-to-date with the topics you care about effortlessly.
Live Sports Coverage:
Never miss a moment of the action with our extensive coverage of our rugby and football teams. Get the latest team news, interviews, expert analysis and more. 
What's On: 
Plan your weekends with ease and stay up to date with Welsh culture, from the biggest gig announcements to the latest restaurant reviews.
Interactive Features:
Share articles with friends, leave comments, and participate in polls to voice your opinions.
Save For Later:
Save articles to read later, even when you're offline, so you can enjoy your news on the go, anytime. 
The Edit
A weekly curation of our best long reads selected by our editors. 
The Digest
A specially curated round-up of the most important stories to catch you up on anything you might have missed.
_____________________________
To unlock all features of the app, an active subscription is required. 
Subscribers benefit from unlimited access to our journalism, including premium analysis and opinion articles, listen to articles, unique puzzles and more.

The best way to get the most from this app is with Daily Record Premium
Ad-lite*, a cleaner and faster reading experience
Access to exclusive subscriber-only journalism and all our newsroom’s brilliant content across website and app
Daily puzzles: unlock crosswords, sudoku & more each day
Bespoke special offers, rewards & competitions from our partners

To view our latest introductory offers, please check the app.

bluejetty:00064817:ios.description:
Edge is a cryptocurrency and Bitcoin wallet built for total financial privacy and security. 
Take control of your crypto and manage it with the familiarity and ease of mobile banking. All you need to log in is a simple username and password - no manual seed phrase backup required (but seed phrases can always be accessed in the app). 
Edge provides top-tier security — neither Edge or any 3rd party can access your cryptocurrency wallet or transaction data. You get the financial privacy and autonomy that crypto & blockchain were designed for.
Buy, sell & store over 120 Cryptocurrencies, including: Bitcoin (BTC), Avalanche (AVAX), Solana (SOL), Monero (XMR), Polygon (MATIC), Hedera (HBAR), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Litecoin (LTC), Binance Coin (BNB), Tezos, Ethereum (ETH), Ripple (XRP), Binance Chain (BNB), RSK (RBTC), Stellar (XLM), Tezos (XTZ), Ravencoin (RVN), SmartCash (SMART), Zcoin (XZC), Dogecoin (DOGE), Feathercoin (FTC), and much more. 
—-----
KEY FEATURES
—-----
• Secure & Private Crypto Wallet – A self-custody wallet where you control your private keys
• Buy, Sell & Exchange Cryptocurrency – Swap Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Monero, Hedera, Avalanche, Dogecoin and more with ease
• Zero-Knowledge Architecture – Edge has no access to your funds or record of transaction data when sending or receiving 
• No Seed Phrase Required – Eliminate the risk of losing your seed phrase and funds with a user-friendly username and password login (seed phrases can be accessed in-app at any time)
• User-Friendly Interface – Designed for both beginners and experienced crypto users who value security, privacy and ease of use
• Hierarchical Deterministic (HD) Wallets – Automatically changes addresses per transaction for additional security and privacy
• Decentralized Server Architecture – Send, receive, and store crypto even if the Edge servers are down
• Built-in Crypto Exchange – Instantly swap Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Monero, and other cryptocurrencies
—-----
OVER 120 SUPPORTED CRYPTOCURRENCIES
—-----
Edge Wallet allows you to store, send, and receive over 120+ cryptocurrencies, Including: Bitcoin (BTC), Avalanche (AVAX), Solana (SOL), Monero (XMR), Polygon (MATIC), Hedera (HBAR), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Litecoin (LTC), Binance Coin (BNB), Tezos, Ethereum (ETH), Ripple (XRP), Binance Chain (BNB), RSK (RBTC), Stellar (XLM), Tezos (XTZ), Ravencoin (RVN), SmartCash (SMART), Zcoin (XZC), Dogecoin (DOGE), Feathercoin (FTC), and much more. 
Want to see other cryptos in our wallet? Send us a request!
—-----

Welcome to Butt Workout by 7M, your ultimate personal trainer for shaping, toning, and strengthening your glutes, right in your pocket. Never miss out on achieving your fitness goals, regardless of how busy your schedule is!
Our app is purpose-built with quick, yet powerful routines meticulously designed to give you the best results in the least amount of time. Whether you're at home, work, or on the go, Butt Workout by 7M is your perfect companion toward a fitter, healthier you.
What sets us apart?
Effective Workouts: Our workouts are created by certified fitness professionals to ensure you maximize each session. Get ready for a mix of squats, lunges, deadlifts, bridges, and more — all scientifically optimized to shape and tone your glutes.
Personalized Programs: Tailored to your fitness level and goals, our app adjusts workout routines, making each session perfect for you. It's like having a personal trainer always ready at your service.
User-Friendly Interface: The design is intuitive and easy to navigate. Set workout reminders, track your progress, and view your workout history effortlessly.
Workout Anywhere: Our workouts are designed for any setting — home, hotel room, or even the office. Get fit anytime, anywhere.
Progress Tracking: Visualize your journey with the app's in-built progress tracker. See your achievements, celebrate victories, and stay motivated as you inch closer to your goals.
Educational Content: Along with our top-notch workouts, the app offers fitness tips, advice, and articles to help you understand the "why" behind each routine.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You should always consult your physician or doctor before starting any new fitness program.
This app integrates with the Apple Health app.

Privacy Policy: https://www.workoutinc.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00135313:ios.description:
Step into the glamorous world of fashion design with Fashion Maker, the mobile application that transforms your creative dreams into runway-worthy reality. Immerse yourself in a world of limitless style possibilities with our feature-packed platform, designed for fashionistas, artists, and visionaries alike.
Embark on Your Fashion Journey with These Exciting Features:
Model Templates: Dive right into the world of haute couture with a stunning array of model templates. From sassy catwalk struts to elegant red carpet poses, find the perfect muse for your creations.
Clothing Templates: Explore an opulent wardrobe of clothing templates that span the fashion spectrum, from haute elegance to street chic. Elevate your designs with the finest cuts, fabrics, and silhouettes, each one handpicked for your imagination.
Texture Brushes: Paint fashion to life with an awe-inspiring array of texture brushes. Whether it's the luxurious sheen of satin, the intricate weave of tweed, or the delicate lacework of evening gowns, every stroke tells a story.
Color Palette: Conjure your fashion vision with a mesmerizing spectrum of colors at your fingertips. Craft palettes that mirror your mood, or tap into our curated collections inspired by the latest trends and timeless classics.
Layering and Undo/Redo: Craft perfection layer by layer. Our intuitive interface empowers you with unlimited layers, ensuring that every detail is honed to precision. Fear not the eraser; unlimited undo and redo are your guiding stars.
Accessories Galore: Complete your ensembles with a treasure trove of accessories. From statement jewelry to finely crafted footwear, every detail counts in the world of fashion.
Export and Share: Turn your sketches into digital haute couture. Export your masterpieces in high-resolution glory, ready to dazzle your social media followers, adorn your portfolio, or grace the pages of your digital fashion diary.
In-App Tutorials: Elevate your skills with a collection of in-app tutorials and expert tips. Let seasoned fashion gurus guide you in unlocking the secrets of the catwalk.
Offline Mode: Create anywhere, anytime, even when the world sleeps. No need to wait for inspiration – let it flow freely, online or offline.
Why Fashion Maker?
FashionSketch Pro isn't just an app; it's your personal atelier, your canvas, and your passport to the world of high fashion. Whether you're a budding fashionista, a seasoned designer, or simply someone who dreams in textures and colors, our app empowers you to craft, create, and conquer the runway with your unique style.
The world of fashion is at your fingertips. Download Fashion Maker today and transform your imagination into fashion magic that's bound to captivate the world. It's more than an app; it's your ticket to the forefront of style innovation. Elevate your sketches, and let your fashion fantasies flourish like never before.

Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Tyyn09PrK5RNt55IP1Fd0pw_B1yNuRNDgIxxs_ZJasc/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00166558:ios.description:
Welcome to Connect: Pair Tile Match! A relaxing and enjoyable way to make the most of your free time. Connect a myriad of pictures in pairs within a limited time, and add extra fun with delightful background music! Challenge your memory and concentration as you connect matching pairs and eliminate them within the given time frame. Download now and immerse yourself in the ultimate Onet Puzzle experience!

- Use polylines to connect two identical tiles and eliminate them. 
- Polylines must have no more than 3 inflection points. 
- The challenge intensifies with higher levels, featuring more grids and matching types. 
- Strategically use props to enhance your gameplay. 
- Successful matches earn higher scores and levels. 
- Be mindful of time limits as you progress through each level. 
Features:
- Find two identical tiles with no other tiles blocking them! 
- Enhance memory and concentration through engaging gameplay. 
- Play anytime, anywhere - no Wi-Fi required! 
- Choose from 30+ well-designed themes, providing endless enjoyment. 
- Immerse yourself in a game filled with vibrant sound effects and music. 
- Stay motivated with the treasure chest feature. 
Download Connect: Pair Tile Match now and invite your friends to play together for even more fun!

bluejetty:00137323:ios.description:
Yoti is your secure digital ID.
Your digital ID gives you a safe and convenient way to prove who you are to businesses and individuals. It’s been certified to the UK Government’s Digital Identity and Attributes Trust Framework.
What you can do with Yoti
• Prove your identity or age to businesses.
• Securely store and share credentials issued to you by third parties, including staff ID cards.
• Get an extra layer of security when you log in to online accounts.
• Manage all your logins with our free password manager.
Your details are safe
Add details to your Yoti by scanning a government-approved ID document. We accept passports, driving licences, PASS cards and national ID cards from 200+ countries.
Any details you add to your Yoti are encrypted into unreadable data that only you can unlock. The private encryption key to your data is stored safely on your phone – only you can activate this key and access your details using your PIN, Face ID or Touch ID.
Protecting your privacy
We cannot share your details without your permission or mine or sell your data to third parties.
We encourage businesses to only ask for the details they need, so when you choose to share your details with a business using Yoti, you can feel safe sharing less data.
Create your digital ID in minutes
1. Add a phone number and create a 5 digit PIN to protect your account.
2. Take a quick scan of your face to verify yourself and protect your account.
3. Scan your ID document to add your details.
Join over 20 million people who have already downloaded the Yoti app.

bluejetty:00039542:ios.summary: نؤمن أن كل رؤيا تحمل رسالة ، وكل رمز و حلم في منامك قصة تنتظر من يفهمها ويترجمها لك إلى لغة حية تلامس روحك، يهدف تطبيق تأويل رؤياي إلى خدمة المستخدم وتوعيته وتسهيل عملية التواصل بينه وبين معبرين بطريقة مقننّه وميسرة حيث ستكون له الأولوية في
bluejetty:00039542:ios.description:
نؤمن أن كل رؤيا تحمل رسالة ، وكل رمز و حلم في منامك قصة تنتظر من يفهمها ويترجمها لك إلى لغة حية تلامس روحك، يهدف تطبيق تأويل رؤياي إلى خدمة المستخدم وتوعيته وتسهيل عملية التواصل بينه وبين معبرين بطريقة مقننّه وميسرة حيث ستكون له الأولوية في تعبير المنامات بشكل فوري وبحسب الشروط والتعليمات المذكورة داخل التطبيق
للباحثين عن تأويل الرؤى والأحلام نقدم لكم معبرين متميزين على منهج الكتاب والسنة الذين يتمتعون بخبرة طويلة في تحليل و تفسير الرؤيا
‏يتم تفسير الرؤى لدينا بشكل فوري مباشر أو يوم إلى حد أقصى ثلاثة أيام ، إذ أن تفسير الرؤى يحتاج للتأمل والتفكير والنظر في الأدلة والبينات والتركيز وصفاء الذهن، وقد نُقل عن أبي علي الخياط – وكان من أهل المعرفة في تعبير الرؤى – أنه طُلب منه تفسير رؤيا، فاستأذن ليلةً ليتأمل ويتدبّر القرآن تلك الليلة ، ثم جاء في اليوم التالي في تفسير الرؤيا مستندًا إلى تدبره للقرآن الكريم، فكان في ذلك نفع وشفاء ، مما يُبرز أهمية التأني في تعبير الرؤيا
استفد من خدمة تفسير الأحلام لدينا، حيث يعمل مفسر الأحلام على تقديم تفسير الرؤى الشرعية و تعبير الأحلام بطريقة مبسطة وميسرة تُلبي حاجتك لفهم كل معاني الأحلام و رموز الأحلام حتى يكون تفسير حلم بطريقة تنير دربك وتلامس روحك.
حمّل التطبيق الآن واستمتع بتجربة تفسير رؤاك بكل ثقة واحترافية

bluejetty:00160080:ios.description:
Discover the heart of local flavour with Valley Eats, your go-to small-town food delivery service. Proudly Canadian-owned and operated, we're on a mission to bring the culinary gems of your favourite local restaurants straight to your doorstep.
Why Valley Eats?
Hungry for convenience? With Valley Eats, satisfying your cravings has never been easier. Whether you prefer pre-ordering, picking up, or having your meal delivered, we've got you covered. Choose from a diverse range of restaurants and cuisines, all tailored to suit your tastes.
What the App Brings to Your Table:
- Seamless On-the-Go Ordering: Ordering is a breeze, even on the busiest days.
- Extensive Delivery Range: We deliver to a wide area, ensuring that even the coziest corners of small towns get a taste of something special.
- Real-Time Order Tracking: Stay in the loop with real-time updates on your order's journey from the kitchen to your doorstep.
- Flexible Payment Options: Pay your way with multiple options – Credit Card, Visa/Mastercard Debit, Apple Pay, and preloaded credit cards.
- Valley Eats Credits: Add credits to your account for seamless and swift transactions.
- Gifting Made Easy: Share the love with friends by sending a Valley Eats gift card.
- Spread the Joy: Recommend your favourite local restaurant to friends right from the app.
Serving Communities Across Canada:
Currently, Valley Eats is delighting taste buds in Arnprior, Carleton Place/Almonte, Deep River, Embrun/Casselman, Kemptville, Pembroke/Petawawa, Perth, Renfrew, Smiths Falls, Port Elgin/Southampton, Hanover/Walkerton, and surrounding areas.
Join Us in the Culinary Journey:
Whether you're a local business wanting to join the food revolution or simply curious to learn more, visit Valley Eats.

- A variety of musical genres including jazz, classical, pop and more.
- A practice mode that uses spaced repetition.
- Sign in to track your progress and compete with other musicians. 
- Never run out of ways to keep learning with regular updates and new content.

bluejetty:00022229:ios.name: tardigrain
bluejetty:00022229:ios.summary: Tardigrain is a granular synthesiser for iOS that runs standalone or as an AU plugin. Sounds are created by taking smaller fragments of a sample and playing them back in a non linear fashion, with settings for grain size, direction, step si
bluejetty:00022229:ios.description:
Tardigrain is a granular synthesiser for iOS that runs standalone or as an AU plugin. Sounds are created by taking smaller fragments of a sample and playing them back in a non linear fashion, with settings for grain size, direction, step size and more. Process the sound further through effects like reverb, wave shaper and sample crush. Tardigrain supports connections with AudioCopy, AudioBus, Inter App Audio and AUv3. Plus all audio parameters can be modulated by MIDI, as AU parameters and by aftertouch on the build in keyboard. Now also a selected set of parameters can be modulated by LFOs och notes triggered by a new sequencer/arpeggiator. 
+++ Record your own samples or import using AudioCopy/drag'n drop
+++ Chromatic granualar playpack
+++ Effects (Wave shaper, Reverb, Sample crusher, Pitch and stereo spread)
+++ Resonant filter (low, band and high pass)
+++ Keyboard and MPE modulation of any audio parameters
+++ Note trigger sequencer/arpeggiator
+++ 4 LFO sources for modulating a selected set of parameters
+++ Multiple factory presets to get you started
+++ Save and load your own settings and samples
+++ Inter App Audio, AudioBus and AUv3
+++ Core MIDI, Inter App Audio MIDI and AUv3 MIDI

To learn more about our digital measurement products and your choices in regard to them, please visit http://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information.
Currently, the AMC app is available for download in the United States and U.S. territories including American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Puerto Rico, US Military, United States Minor Outlying Islands and US Virgin Islands. The AMC app is not available to download in Canada and all other non-US territories.
Privacy Policy: https://www.amc.com/privacy-premiere
Terms of Use: https://www.amc.com/terms-premiere

Play with friends or battle with thousands of other players all over the world. War battle games have never been so close to real-time viking battles as I, Viking is. Immerse yourself into the epic atmosphere of brave medieval gladiators, conquer new territories from your rivals and build viking village. Make your name go down in history!

⚔️Viking village building:A man’s home is his castle. In this vikings game there are 9 levels of each village building to unlock and upgrade.
⚔️Tricky daily tasks let you win bonuses and rewards to continue PvP battles over and over again
Play I, Viking: Epic Vikings War for Valhalla to take part in breathtaking PvP viking battles, feel the spirit of the authentic medieval world with dozens of territories to conquer.
