bluejetty:00018220:ios.name: Paradise Plu$
bluejetty:00018220:ios.summary: The Paradise Plu$ App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay
bluejetty:00018220:ios.description:
The Paradise Plu$ App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Paradise Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Paradise Plu$ App, you must be enrolled as a Paradise Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00172166:ios.description:
Chào mừng đến với vRace – nền tảng thể thao trực tuyến từ FPT Online!
vRace kết nối cộng đồng yêu thể thao, giúp bạn ghi nhận, theo dõi và chinh phục mục tiêu qua các hoạt động chạy bộ, đi bộ, đạp xe và bơi. Từ luyện tập hằng ngày đến tham gia các giải đấu và thử thách, vRace đồng hành cùng bạn trên mọi hành trình.
* Tính Năng Nổi Bật
- Đa dạng nền tảng: Trải nghiệm vRace trên PC, thiết bị hoặc ứng dụng di động.
- Đa dạng kết nối: Kết nối với các dịch vụ như Strava, Garmin để theo dõi hoạt động của bạn.
- Ghi nhận đa môn: Theo dõi các hoạt động chạy bộ, đi bộ, đạp xe và bơi cùng vRace Connect.
- Tạo và quản lý profile cá nhân, nhóm: Xây dựng cộng đồng và kết nối với người yêu thể thao.
- Dữ liệu đồng bộ liên tục: Thông tin tập luyện được cập nhật hàng ngày.
- Đa dạng "Challenge": Tham gia các thách thức để thử thách bản thân.
Tính năng nổi bật trên Wear OS - vRace Connect
- Đưa trải nghiệm tập luyện của bạn lên một tầm cao mới với ứng dụng vRace Connect dành riêng cho đồng hồ thông minh (Wear OS):
- Chạy bộ độc lập: Tích hợp GPS trên đồng hồ, giúp ghi nhận quãng đường, pace và lộ trình mà không cần mang theo điện thoại.
- Theo dõi tập luyện: Ghi nhận nhịp tim, thời gian, quãng đường và các chỉ số quan trọng, giúp bạn dễ dàng theo dõi hiệu quả mỗi buổi tập.
- Đồng bộ hóa tức thì: Dữ liệu được lưu trên đồng hồ và tự động đồng bộ với ứng dụng vRace trên điện thoại khi có kết nối.
- Giao diện tối ưu: Thiết kế phù hợp với cả màn hình đồng hồ tròn và vuông, hiển thị rõ các thông số cần thiết ngay trong lúc vận động.
- Tiết kiệm pin vượt trội: Tối ưu hoạt động của GPS và cảm biến, hỗ trợ bạn duy trì các buổi tập dài hơn.
- Hỗ trợ chạy ngầm bền bỉ: ghi nhận dữ liệu ngay cả khi màn hình tắt hoặc bạn chuyển sang ứng dụng khác trên đồng hồ.
* Tham Gia vRace - Cực Kỳ Đơn Giản
- Tạo tài khoản dễ dàng thông qua Email/Facebook/Google/Apple ID.
- Đăng ký sự kiện và chọn cự ly phù hợp với thể chất của bạn.
- Kết nối với Strava/Garmin để đồng bộ dữ liệu.
- Tập luyện và chạy đua để đạt được mục tiêu cá nhân.
- Check-in hàng ngày để tích lũy điểm và thăng hạng.
* Phần Thưởng Đặc Biệt:
- Nhận chứng nhận và huy chương điện tử khi hoàn thành sự kiện.
- Đổi điểm tích lũy để nhận vật phẩm hấp dẫn.
- Cơ hội nhận nhiều quà tặng hấp dẫn từ các nhãn hàng đối tác.
* Tin Tức Thể Thao Đa Nguồn
- vRace không chỉ là một nền tảng thể thao, mà còn là nguồn thông tin tin tức đáng tin cậy. Tính năng đặc biệt của chúng tôi là khả năng tổng hợp tin tức từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau, không chỉ về sự kiện vRace mà còn về thể thao nói chung. Đảm bảo bạn luôn cập nhật thông tin mới nhất và thú vị từ thế giới thể thao.
- Lưu ý: các bài viết tin tức trên vRace không mang tính chất tư vấn về y tế. Chúng tôi không chịu trách nhiệm về nội dung, chỉ số y tế sức khỏe được bài viết đề cập tới. Mục tiêu là cung cấp thông tin giáo dục và giải trí cho cộng đồng yêu thể thao.
vRace – Ghi nhận từng bước chạy, kết nối cộng đồng và chinh phục những mục tiêu mới.

bluejetty:00061156:ios.name: Bible - The Word of Promise®
bluejetty:00061156:ios.summary:
FREE: The entire Gospel of John (2 hours, 14 minutes) text, study notes and audio featuring Lou Gossett, Jr. as John. 
Bonus: At any time you can purchase the complete Word of Promise® Audio Bible Old & New Testament, and/or the complete
bluejetty:00061156:ios.description:
FREE: The entire Gospel of John (2 hours, 14 minutes) text, study notes and audio featuring Lou Gossett, Jr. as John. 
Bonus: At any time you can purchase the complete Word of Promise® Audio Bible Old & New Testament, and/or the complete NKJV Bible text and the complete NKJV Study Bible (Concordance, Scripture References, Word Studies and more).
The Word of Promise® Audio Bible is a scripted dramatization of the trusted New King James Version (NKJV) of the Bible presented in a compelling, dramatic audio theater format. The audio project took over 4 years to produce and features an All Star Cast including the talents of actors: Jim Caviezel (The Passion of the Christ and Person of Interest) (plays the role of Jesus), Michael York (narrator), Richard Dreyfuss (Moses), Gary Sinise (David), Jesse McCartney (young David and Daniel), Stacy Keach (Paul and Job), Ernie Hudson (Peter), Sean Austin (Elihu), Malcolm McDowell (Solomon), Joan Allen (Deborah), Lou Diamond Phillips (Mark), Luke Perry (Judas), Harry Hamlin (Nehemiah), and Martin Jarvis (voice of God). Complete with production by AFTRA Award winner Carl Amari (The Twilight Zone™ Radio Dramas), an original music score by prolific Italian composer Stefano Mainetti (Abba Pater & The Shooter), and movie-quality sound effects produced, engineered, and mixed at Cerny American Creative in Chicago—an award-winning facility ranked in the Top 3 in the nation for sound design headed by director JoBe Cerny. Over 90 hours of audio.
In addition to this amazing audio, the Word of Promise App features: 
• Complete text of New King James Version Bible synchronized with audio to the verse
• Search and Go directly to any verse to hear and see the Bible instantly
• Bookmark, highlight or write you own notes
• Use the built-in playlists to access pre-programmed plans that take you through the New Testament in 40 days or the entire Bible in Chronological (timeline) order
• Create your own playlist of verses and share with small groups from church, friends and family
• Sleep timer 
• Christ words highlighted in red 
• Airplay support 
• Support for headphone pause and play buttons 
• Remembers where you left off
• The entire 90-hours of standard audio only uses 1.4 GB or if you have the space or turn on the enhanced audio which uses 4 GB. 
At any time you can add the NKJV Study Bible resources and utilize this powerful app for deeper understanding and study which includes:
• Over 15,000 verse-by-verse study notes
• 150 Bible times and culture notes
• 114 articles on key Bible doctrines
• 350 word studies with Strong's numbers
• "Christ in the Scriptures" feature
• Topical index
• Deluxe Nelson concordance
• Full-color maps
The Word of Promise® Audio Bible has won three Audie Awards from The Audio Publishers Association’s (APA) Audies competition. The audio Bible project took home more Audies than any other title when it was crowned the winner for the “Audio Drama,” “Inspirational/Faith-Based Non-Fiction,” and “Package Design” categories. The Audie Awards is the only awards program in the United States devoted entirely to honoring spoken word entertainment. 
“The cast members were well-chosen. The sheer number of actors and the direction and the quality were effective, impressive, well-packaged, well-organized, and well-done. WOW! This is an audiobook people will hear about for a longtime,” noted the Audie Award judges. 
“The Word of Promise® Audio Bible was a labor of love and I feel truly blessed for it to be honored with three Audie Award awards,” says producer Carl Amari. “Over four years of work and thousands of man hours went into both the creation and promotion of this project and to have The Audio Publishers Association recognize it in this way is a great honor.”

bluejetty:00018969:ios.description:
Adventure as a cat and raise a family of your favorite cat breeds in Cat Sim Online, a new RPG adventure set in a massive 3D world!
Protect your kittens from the wild as you explore the big world for yourself! Play with friends in online multiplayer games and form clans to battle enemies and keep your family safe. Unlock new cat breeds to expand your family and create your own adventure with cats in Cat Sim Online!
Cat Sim Online Features:
Raise a Family
- Customize each cat by name, gender, fur color, clothes and more!
- Breeding games: Watch your family tree grow with multiple generations of cats!
- Each new kitten is playable and can continue the family legacy.
- Unlock new cat breeds with coins earned by leveling up by exploring the world.
Adventure & Battle Enemies 
- Adventure as your favorite cat breeds.
- Protect your family by battling dangerous enemies.
- Take down specific enemies to unlock new fighting achievements.
Explore the Massive 3D World
- Adventure calls! Travel the world full of unique locations.
- Easily navigate the world map – just zoom or rotate the compass.
Online Multiplayer Games 
- Play online with friends and share the glory when you take on enemies together.
- Take on enemies and fight with friends in multiplayer games to protect your cat family.
- Prove your strength against others when you have multiplayer duels.
Clans & Online Leaderboards
- Make the online leaderboards for having a high level, the most clan war points and winning battles.
- Join your other clan member’s adventure when their cats are online.
Raise a family, explore a massive 3D world and battle enemies solo or with friends in online multiplayer games! Make your own adventure in Cat Sim Online!
Download today and start playing as your favorite cat breeds!
We are happy to receive any of your suggestions or ideas for the game – please contact us at:
support@turborocketgames.com
Please note, that we are in no way affiliated with any other animal simulator games developed by other game companies.

bluejetty:00014550:ios.description:
With Paribu, trade Bitcoin, Ethereum, and hundreds of crypto assets, manage your portfolio from a single screen, follow markets with full context, and put your balance to work.
# Discover what’s new
→ In the Assets tab, view all your assets, total value, and portfolio allocation from a single screen.
→ Staking is now on Paribu. Stake assets with flexible and fixed-term stake options, and earn daily rewards.
→ The renewed Markets tab brings prices, news, indicators, and summaries together.
→ Switch between Quick, Standard, and Advanced Trade views. You decide the depth of your trading experience.
→ Get support through live chat without leaving the app.
# Step into Paribu’s secure and easy world
- Create and verify your account and start trading.
- Deposit Turkish Lira 24/7 through Akbank, Ziraat Bankası, VakıfBank, Yapı Kredi, İş Bankası, Fibabanka, Şekerbank, N KOLAY, and Türkiye Finans.
- For other banks, use FAST transfers even outside business hours within FAST limits.
# A wide range of assets
- Trade, deposit, and withdraw over 220 crypto assets, including Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH).
- In the Fan Token category, trade sports club tokens including Beşiktaş Fan Token (BJK), Fenerbahçe Token (FB), and Galatasaray Fan Token (GAL).
- Trade memecoins like PEPE and BONK, as well as projects that combine blockchain and AI, such as FET, GLM, and NEAR.
# Advanced and customizable Trade experience
- Trade from a single screen with market orders, limit orders, or stop-loss options.
- Keep track of your open orders and order history right alongside all market activity.
- Trade your way with three different Trade views:
Quick: Enter an amount and trade in a single step.
Standard: Choose the order type, set the timing, and activate your trade.
Advanced: Plan your trades in detail with professional order management and chart views.
# Portfolio tracking and market alarms
- Track your daily, weekly, and monthly performance from the asset analysis screen.
- Add any market to your favorites.
- Shape your investment decisions by reviewing the last 12 months of price movements with crypto charts.
- Set price alarms for crypto assets and get notified instantly about every market move.
# Put your balance to work with Stake
- Stake assets, including TL, ETH, and SOL, and earn daily rewards.
- Choose when and how your balance earns with flexible and fixed-term stake options.
# Privileges that grow as you use Paribu
- Personalize your Paribu experience with four membership levels: Green, Green+, Black, and Black+.
- Unlock commission discounts, lower withdrawal fees, advantageous Staking rates, and early access privileges at every level.
- Enjoy your privileges across the entire Paribu universe, including Paribu Pass and Paribu Art.
# Competitive commission rates
- As your trading volume increases, your commission rates decrease to as low as 0.01%.
# Absolute security, always
- Every transaction on Paribu is secured by ColdShield®, Paribu’s registered digital asset custody technology that brings together MPC, HSM and Secure Enclave technologies.
# 24/7 support, whenever you need it
- Access 24/7 support from Paribu Support by calling 0850 303 60 00 or emailing destek@paribu.com.
- Get support through live chat without leaving the app.

bluejetty:00071146:ios.summary: Plan your metro trip in Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and Uzbekistan and know how long your journey will take, including any line transfers. The app displays the optimal route, shows which metro car will be most convenient, shows station exits o
bluejetty:00071146:ios.description:
Plan your metro trip in Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and Uzbekistan and know how long your journey will take, including any line transfers. The app displays the optimal route, shows which metro car will be most convenient, shows station exits on the map and forewarns of any closures.
• Metro map with everything you need to know
On the map you can see which stations are closed for repairs, and which stations are best for getting to railway stations and airports. Enlarge the map to see more detail, like different types of interchanges between stations.
• Optimal routes and metro cars for convenient transfers
Yandex Metro shows you how long a journey will take, the number of transfers and whether any stations are closed for renovations. It shows which metro car to choose to speed up your trip and not waste time when changing lines.
Information about metro exits
• Information about metro exits
See detailed information about every station: how many exits and which streets they lead to, working hours and warnings of any closures. Hail a taxi to pick you up from your chosen metro exit right within the app.
• Pay your fare in the app
Use the app to top up Moscow’s Troika and Strelka public transport cards.
• Accessibility
The app supports VoiceOver, so it can be used by people with visual impairments.
• More than 20 schemes
– Russia: Volgograd, Yekaterinburg, Kazan, Moscow, Nizhny Novgorod, Novosibirsk, Samara, St. Petersburg.
- Austria: Vienna.
- Azerbaijan: Baku.
- Armenia: Yerevan.
- Belarus: Minsk.
- Hungary: Budapest.
- Greece: Athens.
- Georgia: Tbilisi.
- Italy: Milan, Rome.
- Kazakhstan: Almaty.
- UAE: Dubai.
- Poland: Warsaw.
- Portugal: Lisbon.
- USA: San Francisco.
- Turkey: Istanbul, Izmir, Adana, Bursa, Ankara.
- Uzbekistan: Tashkent.
- Ukraine: Dnipro, Kiev, Kharkiv.
- Sweden: Stockholm.
- Finland: Helsinki.
- Czech Republic: Prague.

SAVE YOUR OWN DESIGN: Once you've made your masterpiece, it will be automatically save and you can always apply and edit them anywhere.

apple-itunes:1294475478.summary: Download VPSie by Colohost LLC on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like VPSie.
apple-itunes:1294475478.description:
Now you can access your VPSies on the go! We brought VPSie to mobile devices so you always have control of your servers, domains, images, Ips, and other important functions of your cloud infrastructure.
VPSie is a simple hosting platform that helps entrepreneurs & coders develop their dreams on a cloud server hosted in a reliable datacenter within 60 seconds spin-up time for as little as $4 per month.
About US:
First question that comes to our visitor’s mind usually is : What is VPSie? How do I pronounce it?
VPSie stands for : “Virtual Private Server I Expect“
It was a way to eliminate the spelling out of the VPS acronym while adding the personalized ownership “My VPSie” concept.
Pronounce it same way you do with “Pepsi." VPSie is Powerful and Fun!
In our world each server is called “ VPSie” and a group of servers are VPSie(s).
VPSie is a private company owned and operated by group of highly experienced skilled team, Every team member is dedicated to provide exceptional experience to our clients ensuring that our service is tolerated to their business needs and affordable as possible. Most of our engineers achieved academic level industry standard certifications for Cisco, Juniper, Microsoft, VMware, Linux, Oracle and many other.
VPSie is the first automation hosting provider to deliver true cloud hosting with simplicity – Introducing a firewalled dedicated gateway per client within datacenter (PCS : Private Cloud Solution) allowing our clients to complete tasks in few clicks such as port forwarding, NAT, Selective Internet access, Traffic isolation and blocking as well as unmetered private gigabit links within private cloud.
Currently we have presence in data-centers in New York, New Jersey, Virginia, California in the USA and Amsterdam is the first European presence to support our demand in the region, As we grow we are adding more locations to provide even more options and flexibility.
Our data-centers standard is minimum of Tier 3 , As a responsible and proactive representative of the hosting industry, Hosting complies rigidly with standards of SSAE 16, CSAE 3416, ISAE 3402, PCI DDS, HIPPA, and Safe Harbor. These ensure that your business conforms to the highest standards mandated by industry and government authorities.
VPSie is a unique offering – Everything you see is custom made platform from end to end utilizing the power of pure KVM virtualization built on owned infrastructure from core to edge to ensure that our clients have full control over their data, resources and access.
Delivering a unique complete feature set with simplicity – Giving our clients the power to achieve setups that takes days in just few minutes, with great flexibility of future scalability by utilizing template, cloning options as well as load balancing and full DNS management.
We take data security seriously as we have implemented full isolation of client traffic from other clients within the same datacenter as well as delivering flexible recovery options in case of disasters such as snapshots, on-demand backup and daily full automated backups.
Our dedicated team is working hard on delivering new features and enhancements, Most likely you would see changes on your dashboard frequently – We hope you utilize our live support chat and talk to us about what you like and what you don’t like in our platform.

apple-macos:6825175034.name: Vesica - Bible, Notes, Ask AI
apple-macos:6825175034.description:
“Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” James 4:8
The name Vesica is a reference to Vesica Pisces, the fish symbol associated with Jesus.
Vesica is a Bible made for time with God. Most Bible apps compete for your attention; Vesica keeps it on Him. There is only the page, turning like paper, and beside it a notebook for what He is showing you, in your own handwriting or typed. Each morning begins with a prayer from Scripture. No feed, no streaks, no ads, and no account needed to read.
NOTHING BETWEEN YOU AND HIS WORD
• Pages turn like a real book, with two-page spreads on iPad
• The words of Jesus in red, classic book margins, chapter heads in small caps
• Six typefaces made for long reading, and five page colors from warm Vellum to Midnight
• Tools appear when you tap the middle of the page, then step aside while you read
• Works offline: all 11 translations are built in
WRITE WHAT HE'S SHOWING YOU
• Every chapter has its own notebook, beside the page on iPad and below it on iPhone
• Write with Apple Pencil or type. Pan and zoom, so a sketch can grow into a mind map
• Underline and write on the Bible page itself, as in a paper Bible. Your ink stays with its words
• Come back months later and see what He taught you
• Highlight the verses that speak to you, a whole verse or just a few words, and find them again in one place
BEGIN EACH DAY IN PRAYER
• He speaks in His Word; you answer Him in prayer
• The first time you open Vesica each day, a Prayer of the Day from Scripture is waiting, most of them from the Psalms
• It's yours alone, and the same on all your devices
UNDERSTAND WHAT YOU READ (OPTIONAL)
• When a passage is hard, ask about the verse in front of you and get an answer grounded in Scripture
• Every verse it cites is quoted from your own Bible, with links that open the passage
• Each answer ends with what to read next, so it leads you deeper into the Word, not away from it
• Your chats are kept for you, privately, in your iCloud
• Ask uses Sign in with Apple and is free up to a daily limit. Vesica Plus raises it to 100 questions a day
YOUR TIME WITH HIM, ON EVERY DEVICE
• iPhone in the morning, iPad or Mac at night: all kept in step through your own iCloud
• Nothing is lost: edits from two devices are merged, and anything you delete waits 30 days in Recently Deleted
• Private: no ads, no analytics, no tracking
11 FREE TRANSLATIONS
English: Berean Standard Bible, World English Bible, WEB with Deuterocanon, King James Version (outside the UK)
Español: Nueva Biblia Viva, La Biblia en Español Sencillo, Reina-Valera 1909
Português: Bíblia Livre, Bíblia Portuguesa Mundial
Français: Louis Segond 1910
Deutsch: Lutherbibel 1912
Switch any time. Your highlights and notes stay with their verses.
“Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.” John 17:3
VESICA PLUS
An optional auto-renewing subscription for up to 100 questions a day in Ask: US$3.99 a month or US$24.99 a year, or the equivalent in your currency. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vesicabible.com/privacy
